articles.title: Jalen Brunson is afraid to open the bag containing his NBA championship hat because of horrors inside

paras.en: You'd think that a player's NBA Championship hat would be one of their prized possessions, but when it's carrying the potential funk factor that New York Knicks star Jalen Brunson's might be, perhaps not so much.
paras.zh: 你可能会认为球员的 NBA 总冠军帽子是他们最珍贵的财产之一，但当它带有纽约尼克斯队球星贾伦·布伦森的潜在恐惧因素时，也许就不那么重要了。

paras.en: The Knicks locked up their first NBA title in decades back in June, and after all of the festivities, Brunson revealed that his championship lid is still packed away in a bag.
paras.zh: 尼克斯队在六月份锁定了他们几十年来的第一个 NBA 冠军，在所有的庆祝活动之后，布伦森透露他的冠军盖子仍然装在袋子里。

paras.en: And the potential horrors within are keeping him from opening it.
paras.zh: 而里面潜在的恐怖让他无法打开它。

paras.en: "Mine is still not washed; it’s in the bag, and I’m afraid to open it," Brunson said on a recent episode of his podcast "Roommates Show" with teammate Josh Hart. "It smells terrible: Champagne, sweat, cigars, food, beer, tequila."
paras.zh: “我的还没洗；它在包里，我不敢打开它，”布伦森在最近与队友乔什·哈特一起做的播客“室友秀”节目中说道。 “闻起来很糟糕：香槟、汗水、雪茄、食物、啤酒、龙舌兰酒。”

paras.en: That sounds like the notes of the worst cologne of all time.
paras.zh: 这听起来像是有史以来最糟糕的古龙水的味道。

paras.en: That's a recipe for some serious stink, and that's why on the off chance you ever win a championship (hey, it could happen; your church league softball team could be a wagon next season) you've got to suck it up, let it air out and wash it.
paras.zh: 这会导致一些严重的臭味，这就是为什么一旦你有机会赢得冠军（嘿，这可能会发生；你的教会联盟垒球队下个赛季可能会变成一辆马车）你必须把它吸起来，让它通风并清洗它。

paras.en: What you don't want to do is leave it in a sealed bag like Brunson has done. Now he's got a science fair project on his hands.
paras.zh: 你不想做的就是像布伦森那样将其放在密封袋中。现在他手上有一个科学博览会项目。

paras.en: Not only will that thing smell so bad it'll make your hair fall out, at this point it could have a small civilization growing on it, or it could've sprouted a set of eyes.
paras.zh: 那东西不仅气味难闻，会让你的头发掉光，此时它上面可能会生长出一个小型文明，或者它可能会长出一双眼睛。

paras.en: I know someone — it was not me, I swear — who left a sweaty hat in a bag for quite some time, and then, after a bit, put it in their closet.
paras.zh: 我认识一个人——我发誓不是我——他把一顶出汗的帽子放在包里很长一段时间，然后过了一会儿，把它放进了衣柜里。

paras.en: However, this closet was accessed through the bathroom; therefore, it maintained the right level of humidity for some kind of mold or fungus or alien entity to start growing from this hat.
paras.zh: 然而，这个壁橱是通过浴室进入的；因此，它保持了适当的湿度水平，适合某种霉菌、真菌或外来实体从这顶帽子开始生长。

paras.en: It was a horror show, and unfortunately, that may be the fate of Jalen Brunson's NBA Championship hat.
paras.zh: 这是一场恐怖的表演，不幸的是，这可能就是杰伦·布伦森 NBA 冠军帽子的命运。

paras.en: I hope I'm wrong, but if there's one thing I know, it's the do's and do-not-do's of hat funk.
paras.zh: 我希望我是错的，但如果我知道一件事，那就是帽子放克的该做和不该做。

articles.title: Rain forces MLB to postpone Guardians-Rays ALCS Game 4 in Cleveland

paras.en: Steady rain in Cleveland forced MLB to postpone Game 4 of the American League Championship Series. The stadium grounds crew was forced to pull the tarp well before the scheduled 8 p.m. ET first pitch.
paras.zh: 克利夫兰的持续降雨迫使美国职业棒球大联盟推迟了美国联盟冠军系列赛的第四场比赛。体育场地勤人员被迫在预定的晚上 8 点之前拉开防水布。 ET 第一节投球。

paras.en: The grounds crew continued working in an effort to salvage the game, but by approximately 9 p.m. ET, the league announced the game had been moved to Saturday. The postponement also pushed Game 5 to Sunday, eliminating the scheduled off day and travel day for the Cleveland Guardians and Tampa Bay Rays.
paras.zh: 场地工作人员继续努力挽救比赛，但到了晚上 9 点左右。东部时间，联盟宣布比赛已移至周六。推迟还将第五场比赛推迟到周日，取消了克利夫兰守护者队和坦帕湾光芒队的原定休息日和旅行日。

paras.en: Should the series go the distance, the Guardians and Rays will play four games in four days to determine which advances to the World Series. Games 6 and 7 were already scheduled for consecutive days, Monday and Tuesday.
paras.zh: 如果系列赛能够走到最后，守护者队和光芒队将在四天内打四场比赛，以确定哪支球队晋级世界大赛。第六场和第七场比赛已经安排在连续几天，周一和周二进行。

paras.en: In a statement acknowledging the inclement weather, the Guardians also said tickets purchased for Friday night’s game would be honored.
paras.zh: 在一份承认天气恶劣的声明中，卫报还表示，购买周五晚上比赛的门票将得到尊重。

paras.en: "Fans with tickets to the original ALCS Game 4 on Friday, October 16 may use those same tickets for ALCS Game 5 on Sunday, October 18 at 5:00 p.m. ET. Gates will open at 2:30 p.m. ET."
paras.zh: “持有 10 月 16 日星期五原版 ALCS 第 4 场比赛门票的球迷可以使用同样的门票参加 10 月 18 日星期日下午 5:00 美国东部时间的 ALCS 第五场比赛。门票将于美国东部时间下午 2:30 开放。”

paras.en: Before tonight’s decision, it had been nearly four years since rain forced a postseason game to be rescheduled. The previous rainout came on Halloween in 2022, pushing Game 3 of the World Series between the Houston Astros and Philadelphia Phillies to the following day. Philadelphia shut out Houston 7-0 on Nov. 1, 2022.
paras.zh: 在今晚做出决定之前，自从雨水迫使季后赛重新安排以来已经过去近四年了。上一次降雨发生在 2022 年的万圣节，将休斯敦太空人队和费城费城人队之间的世界大赛第三场比赛推迟到第二天。 2022 年 11 月 1 日，费城队以 7-0 击败休斯顿队。

articles.title: NCAA moves to block Ohio Governor Mike DeWine's executive order expanding college athletes' eligibility

paras.en: The NCAA filed a lawsuit against Ohio Gov. Mike DeWine on Friday, escalating a dispute that began three days earlier when he signed an executive order giving state universities the option to allow athletes who graduated from high school in 2022 to compete for a fifth college season.
paras.zh: NCAA 周五对俄亥俄州州长迈克·德温 (Mike DeWine) 提起诉讼，加剧了三天前开始的争端，当时他签署了一项行政命令，允许州立大学选择允许 2022 年高中毕业的运动员参加第五个大学赛季的比赛。

paras.en: The order challenges a new NCAA eligibility rule that excludes those athletes.
paras.zh: 该命令挑战了新的 NCAA 资格规则，该规则将这些运动员排除在外。

paras.en: The suit was filed in federal court in Ohio. NCAA President Charlie Baker described taking the legal action as an "extraordinary step" intended to prevent DeWine from making it "impossible for all schools to compete on a level playing field."
paras.zh: 该诉讼已向俄亥俄州联邦法院提起。 NCAA 主席查理·贝克 (Charlie Baker) 称采取法律行动是“非同寻常的一步”，旨在阻止德温让“所有学校无法在公平的竞争环境中竞争”。

paras.en: In the lawsuit, the NCAA accused DeWine, a two-term Republican governor, of trying to give Ohio athletes "a hall pass" from following NCAA rules.
paras.zh: 在诉讼中，NCAA 指控两届共和党州长德温试图给俄亥俄州运动员“通行证”，使其不遵守 NCAA 规则。

paras.en: DeWine’s executive order and the NCAA’s lawsuit in response mark the latest escalation in a wave of legal maneuvering that is reshaping college sports rules on a state-by-state basis.
paras.zh: 德温的行政命令和 NCAA 的回应诉讼标志着法律行动浪潮的最新升级，这一浪潮正在逐州重塑大学体育规则。

paras.en: The latest clash quickly prompted reactions from across the college athletics landscape. "This whole thing has become comical," University of Tennessee athletic director Danny White said on social media in reaction to the NCAA announcement.
paras.zh: 最近的冲突很快引起了整个大学体育界的反应。 “这整件事变得很滑稽，”田纳西大学体育总监丹尼·怀特在社交媒体上回应 NCAA 的声明时说道。

paras.en: Ohio’s eight Division I programs have yet to publicly weigh in on DeWine’s order. The measure has received support from Lt. Gov. Jim Tressel, a championship-winning former coach at Ohio State and Youngstown State. The state’s Division I ranks include No. 4 Ohio State of the Big Ten, Cincinnati of the Big 12 and six members of the Mid-American Conference.
paras.zh: 俄亥俄州的八个一级项目尚未公开对德温的命令发表意见。这项措施得到了副州长吉姆·特雷塞尔（Jim Tressel）的支持，他是俄亥俄州立大学和扬斯敦州立大学的前冠军教练。该州一级联赛排名包括十大联盟中排名第四的俄亥俄州立大学、十大联盟中排名第四的辛辛那提大学以及中美洲联盟的六名成员。

paras.en: Under DeWine's order, public and private universities in Ohio would be able to allow the Class of ’22 athletes to play, even though the NCAA’s new guidance excludes those who have already played four seasons. The rule, passed in June, is the subject of multiple court fights.
paras.zh: 根据德温的命令，俄亥俄州的公立和私立大学将能够允许 22 届运动员参加比赛，尽管 NCAA 的新指导方针排除了那些已经参加了四个赛季的运动员。这项于六月通过的规则引起了多次法庭争论。

paras.en: DeWine’s office declined to comment on the lawsuit. Although it is unusual for the NCAA to sue a governor, the organization has done so before. In the early 1990s, the NCAA prevailed in a case against then-Nevada Gov. Bob Miller over a state law that would have required the association to provide greater due-process protections during enforcement proceedings.
paras.zh: 德温办公室拒绝就该诉讼发表评论。尽管 NCAA 起诉州长的情况并不常见，但该组织以前也这样做过。 20 世纪 90 年代初，NCAA 在针对当时的内华达州州长鲍勃·米勒 (Bob Miller) 的诉讼中胜出，因为该州法律要求该协会在执法程序中提供更大的正当程序保护。

paras.en: In its court filing, the NCAA said it was trying "to halt a misguided attempt to give Ohio colleges and universities an unfair, unprecedented and unwarranted competitive advantage in stadiums and arenas throughout the country."
paras.zh: NCAA 在法庭文件中表示，它正在试图“阻止一种误导性的尝试，即为俄亥俄州的学院和大学在全国各地的体育场馆和竞技场中提供不公平、史无前例和无根据的竞争优势。”

paras.en: "College sports, like all sports, depend on participants following the rules. (DeWine) is attempting to give Ohio institutions a hall pass to break the rules," the lawsuit says.
paras.zh: “大学体育运动，像所有体育运动一样，取决于参与者遵守规则。（德温）试图给俄亥俄州的机构一张违反规则的通行证，”诉讼称。

paras.en: The Ohio Supreme Court has already said it will determine the legality of the executive order. As part of that, it paused an appeals court ruling in a case there that had declared the ’22 athletes ineligible; the court asked both sides to file briefs in the case, in which basketball player Filip Borovićanin is the lead plaintiff, by next Monday.
paras.zh: 俄亥俄州最高法院已经表示将确定该行政命令的合法性。作为其中的一部分，它暂停了上诉法院对该案件的裁决，该案件宣布 22 名运动员没有参赛资格；法院要求双方在下周一之前提交案件摘要，其中篮球运动员 Filip Borovićanin 是主要原告。

paras.en: Baker said the NCAA did not believe the Supreme Court's order did, in fact, declare those players immediately eligible to compete.
paras.zh: 贝克表示，NCAA 并不认为最高法院的命令实际上宣布了这些球员立即有资格参加比赛。

paras.en: That case, like others around the country, is becoming more urgent by the day, as it involves football players, along with a handful of basketball players whose status for the upcoming season is in jeopardy. Among them: Gonzaga transfer Javon Bennett, Cincinnati's MJ Collins and Borovićanin himself, who played in an exhibition against Tennessee on Thursday night after DeWine's order put him back on the eligible list.
paras.zh: 与全国各地的其他案件一样，这一案件正变得越来越紧迫，因为它涉及足球运动员，以及少数篮球运动员，他们在即将到来的赛季中的地位处于危险之中。其中包括冈萨加转会的贾文·贝内特、辛辛那提的 MJ·柯林斯和博罗维奇本人。博罗维奇在周四晚上对阵田纳西州的一场表演赛中，在德维恩的命令将他重新列入合格名单后。

paras.en: For years, the NCAA has urged Congress to pass federal legislation that would curb lawsuits challenging its rules, which govern hundreds of thousands of athletes nationwide. The Senate has sent the Protect College Sports Act, aims to provide that protection, to the House, but its fate remains uncertain in an election year.
paras.zh: 多年来，NCAA 一直敦促国会通过联邦立法，以遏制挑战其规则的诉讼，这些规则管辖着全国数十万运动员。参议院已向众议院提交了旨在提供保护的《保护大学体育法案》，但其命运在选举年仍不确定。

paras.en: The Associated Press contributed to this report.
paras.zh: 美联社对此报道作出了贡献。

articles.title: Mimicking populists will not ease cost of living or boost productivity, Mathias Cormann warns
articles.author: Kat Wong

paras.en: Australia’s mainstream political parties are being warned not to adopt populist policies such as migration caps to address voters’ grievances over the cost of living.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚主流政党被警告不要采取移民上限等民粹主义政策来解决选民对生活成本的不满。

paras.en: Instead, Australia’s longest-serving finance minister, Mathias Cormann, is urging politicians to deliver housing, real wage growth and lower energy costs by boosting productivity.
paras.zh: 相反，澳大利亚任职时间最长的财政部长马蒂亚斯·科尔曼（Mathias Cormann）敦促政界人士通过提高生产率来提供住房、实际工资增长和降低能源成本。

paras.en: Now the secretary general for the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD), Cormann will deliver an address to the Centre for Independent Studies on Saturday night spruiking productivity as the only way to reliably lower the cost of living over the long term.
paras.zh: 现任经济合作与发展组织（OECD）秘书长的科曼将于周六晚上向独立研究中心发表讲话，强调生产力是长期可靠地降低生活成本的唯一途径。

paras.en: Though not directly named in his address, One Nation – which largely runs on an anti-immigration platform – has surged in popularity since the 2025 federal election, with its primary vote reaching 25%, according to the latest Guardian Essential poll, rising above the Coalition’s 22%.
paras.zh: 尽管他的讲话中没有直接点名，但自 2025 年联邦大选以来，一国党——主要在反移民平台上运行——受欢迎程度飙升，根据最新的卫报基本民意调查，其初选得票率达到 25%，高于联盟党的 22%。

paras.en: While populist parties may have gained traction by speaking to real grievances about rising energy bills, home ownership and real incomes going backwards, Cormann is expected to warn Labor and the Coalition not to follow suit.
paras.zh: 虽然民粹主义政党可能通过表达对能源费用上涨、住房拥有率和实际收入倒退的真实不满而获得支持，但预计科曼将警告工党和联盟党不要效仿。

paras.en: “Mainstream parties that respond to a populist surge by adopting its economics do not recover their voters. They lose twice: once to the original, which the electorate will always prefer to the copy, and once to the centre, which has nowhere else to go,” he will say in his address.
paras.zh: 他在讲话中表示：“主流政党通过采用其经济政策来应对民粹主义浪潮，但并没有挽回选民。他们输了两次：一次输给了原党，选民总是更喜欢原党而不是复制品，另一次输给了中间党，后者无处可去。”

paras.en: “The lesson is consistent: deliver homes, lower energy costs, real wage growth and a credible budget, and the populist tide recedes.
paras.zh: “教训是一致的：交付住房、降低能源成本、实际工资增长和可信的预算，以及民粹主义浪潮消退。

paras.en: “Mimic the populists, and you simply confirm that they were right all along. The way to defeat populism is to solve the problems it feeds on.”
paras.zh: “模仿民粹主义者，你只需确认他们一直都是对的。击败民粹主义的方法就是解决它赖以生存的问题。”

paras.en: Cormann will point to “arbitrary migration caps” imposed regardless of their effect on business, hospitals, aged care or universities.
paras.zh: 科曼将指出，无论对企业、医院、老年护理中心或大学的影响如何，都实行“任意移民上限”。

paras.en: He will acknowledge more Australians now than any time in the past 20 years say the migration intake is too high and may support such policies, with many attributing their concerns to housing.
paras.zh: 他承认，现在有比过去 20 年来任何时候都多的澳大利亚人表示移民人数过高，并可能支持此类政策，其中许多人将他们的担忧归咎于住房问题。

paras.en: But the answer is to address housing supply, infrastructure, services and the composition of the migration intake, he will say.
paras.zh: 但他表示，答案是解决住房供应、基础设施、服务和移民人数的构成问题。

paras.en: According to OECD research across Australia’s regions, in places where more migrants arrived, employment among Australian-born workers grew faster, not slower, with no measurable effect on their wages.
paras.zh: 根据经合组织对澳大利亚各地区的研究，在更多移民到达的地方，澳大利亚出生的工人的就业增长更快，而不是更慢，而且对他们的工资没有明显影响。

paras.en: Without migration, Australia’s working-age population would decrease as the number of older people grows.
paras.zh: 如果没有移民，澳大利亚的劳动年龄人口将会随着老年人数量的增加而减少。

paras.en: “An ageing country that chooses to shrink its working-age population while promising to spend more on health, care and defence has not developed a plan – it has put forward a contradiction,” Cormann will say.
paras.zh: “一个选择减少劳动年龄人口、同时承诺增加医疗、护理和国防支出的老龄化国家并没有制定出计划——它提出了一个矛盾，”科尔曼将表示。

paras.en: Tariffs, which have been imposed by US president Donald Trump and proposed by One Nation, would also fail to address the cost of living and could instead raise costs for farmers, miners and builders, Cormann will say.
paras.zh: 科曼表示，由美国总统唐纳德·特朗普征收并由一国党提议的关税也无法解决生活成本问题，反而可能增加农民、矿工和建筑商的成本。

paras.en: He believes Australia can only grow its way out of the issue through productivity.
paras.zh: 他认为澳大利亚只能通过提高生产力来解决这个问题。

paras.en: “There is no shortcut to a lower cost of living. There is no populist shortcut, through tariffs and caps and state banks,” he will say.
paras.zh: “降低生活成本没有捷径。通过关税、上限和国有银行，民粹主义没有捷径，”他会说。

paras.en: “There is only the long way round: an economy that produces more, competes harder and grows faster than its costs … anyone offering you a quicker route is offering you a poorer country.”
paras.zh: “只有长远的路：一个生产更多、竞争更激烈、增长速度超过其成本的经济体……任何为你提供更快路线的人都会为你提供一个更贫穷的国家。”

articles.title: Mexican judge sentences three men to 158 years in prison for murders of Australian and US surfers​
articles.author: Kat Wong with agencies

paras.en: A Mexican judge has sentenced three men to 158 years and nine months in prison each for the murder of two Australian brothers and their American friend during a 2024 surf trip to the state of Baja California.
paras.zh: 一名墨西哥法官判处三名男子 158 年零 9 个月监禁，罪名是在 2024 年下加利福尼亚州冲浪之旅中谋杀了两名澳大利亚兄弟及其美国朋友。

paras.en: The defendants were declared guilty a week ago of homicide, aggravated robbery, robbery with violence and vehicle theft with violence, crimes committed against Australian brothers Jake and Callum Robinson, and their American friend Carter Rhoad.
paras.zh: 一周前，被告被宣布犯有杀人罪、严重抢劫罪、暴力抢劫罪和暴力盗窃车辆罪，以及对澳大利亚兄弟杰克·罗宾逊和卡勒姆·罗宾逊以及他们的美国朋友卡特·罗德犯下的罪行。

paras.en: Rhoad and the Robinsons were shot dead in a suspected robbery while travelling through Mexico.
paras.zh: 罗德和罗宾逊一家在墨西哥旅行时因涉嫌抢劫而被枪杀。

paras.en: They were camping in a remote beachside area near the city of Ensenada when they were attacked on 27 April 2024.
paras.zh: 2024 年 4 月 27 日，他们在恩塞纳达市附近的一个偏远海滨地区露营，遭到袭击。

paras.en: Their bodies were found days later in a clifftop well with gunshot wounds to the heads.
paras.zh: 几天后，他们的尸体在悬崖顶的一口井中被发现，头部有枪伤。

paras.en: Jesus Gerardo – known as “El Kekas” – was accused of leading the attack. His surname has not been disclosed for legal reasons.
paras.zh: 耶稣·赫拉多（Jesus Gerardo）——被称为“El Kekas”——被指控领导了这次袭击。出于法律原因，他的姓氏尚未公开。

paras.en: Two other defendants, Irineo Francisco and Angel Jesus, were also found guilty and have been sentenced.
paras.zh: 另外两名被告 Irineo Francisco 和 Angel Jesus 也被判有罪并被判刑。

paras.en: The families of the victims followed the sentencing hearing via video link.
paras.zh: 受害者家属通过视频连线观看了量刑听证会。

paras.en: Prosecutors had requested damages of more than $100,000 but the judge ruled against it and said any compensation would have to be pursued through civil proceedings.
paras.zh: 检察官要求赔偿超过 10 万美元，但法官驳回了这一要求，并表示任何赔偿都必须通过民事诉讼来寻求。

paras.en: The brothers’ parents, Martin and Debra Robinson, travelled from Australia to the port city of Ensenada for the trial, which began on 7 September.
paras.zh: 兄弟俩的父母马丁·罗宾逊 (Martin Robinson) 和黛布拉·罗宾逊 (Debra Robinson) 从澳大利亚前往港口城市恩塞纳达 (Ensenada) 参加 9 月 7 日开始的审判。

paras.en: They have established a foundation in their sons’ names to carry on their legacy.
paras.zh: 他们以儿子的名义建立了一个基金会来继承他们的遗产。

paras.en: The Callum and Jake Robinson Foundation aims to “help people live bigger, shine brighter and love harder in their honour”.
paras.zh: 卡勒姆和杰克·罗宾逊基金会的目标是“帮助人们生活得更美好、更闪耀、更努力地去爱，以纪念他们”。

paras.en: Callum, the older of the two brothers, moved to the US as a professional lacrosse player and has been remembered for his loving nature and passion for the environment, having been involved in coastal cleanups.
paras.zh: 卡勒姆是两兄弟中的长子，作为一名职业长曲棍球运动员移居美国，并因其热爱的天性和对环境的热情而被人们铭记，并参与了海岸清理工作。

paras.en: Jake, a doctor, was set to take up a position at Geelong hospital after returning to Australia.
paras.zh: 杰克是一名医生，返回澳大利亚后将在吉朗医院任职。

paras.en: He has been remembered for his academic success, his passion for sport, particularly cricket and surfing, and his compassion.
paras.zh: 他因其学术上的成功、对体育运动（尤其是板球和冲浪）的热情以及他的同情心而被人们铭记。

paras.en: Baja California is one of Mexico’s most violent states, plagued by organised crime and drug trafficking, although cartel activity does not usually affect tourists. Other foreign visitors have, however, been targeted in criminal attacks on Mexico’s Pacific coast.
paras.zh: 下加利福尼亚州是墨西哥暴力最严重的州之一，深受有组织犯罪和毒品贩运的困扰，尽管卡特尔活动通常不会影响游客。然而，其他外国游客也成为墨西哥太平洋海岸犯罪袭击的目标。

paras.en: Two Australian surfers, Dean Lucas and Adam Coleman, were killed in 2015 while travelling through the north-western state of Sinaloa. Their bodies were later burned.
paras.zh: 2015 年，两名澳大利亚冲浪运动员迪恩·卢卡斯 (Dean Lucas) 和亚当·科尔曼 (Adam Coleman) 在穿越西北部锡那罗亚州时丧生。他们的尸体后来被烧毁。

articles.title: Not cool: who hacked France’s supermarket fridges?
articles.author: Kim Willsher in Paris

paras.en: Shortly before midnight last Sunday, the digital thermostats controlling hundreds of supermarket cold aisles across France began to flicker and rise.
paras.zh: 上周日午夜前不久，控制法国数百家超市冷通道的数字恒温器开始闪烁并升高。

paras.en: In a “bizarre and unprecedented” cyber-attack, hackers had remotely overridden the temperature settings on thousands of freezers, fridges and chiller cabinets pushing them from as low as -27C (-16.6F) to well over 50C (122F).
paras.zh: 在一次“奇怪且史无前例”的网络攻击中，黑客远程覆盖了数千台冰柜、冰箱和冷冻柜的温度设置，将它们从低至 -27 摄氏度（-16.6 华氏度）提高到远超 50 摄氏度（122 华氏度）。

paras.en: Over the next four to six hours, the food inside first defrosted, then slowly began to cook.
paras.zh: 在接下来的四到六个小时里，里面的食物首先解冻，然后慢慢开始煮。

paras.en: Shop staff arriving early to restock shelves reported catching a blast of hot air, like opening an oven, when they went to fill freezers. One Normandy supermarket reported a number of its freezers had been pushed to 80C (176F). In certain stores, the extreme temperature rise had sparked fires triggering sprinklers and water damage.
paras.zh: 提早到达货架补货的商店工作人员报告说，当他们去给冰柜装货​​时，他们感受到一股热空气，就像打开烤箱一样。诺曼底的一家超市报告称，其许多冰柜的温度已升至 80 摄氏度（176 华氏度）。在某些商店，极端气温上升引发火灾，引发洒水装置和水灾。

paras.en: “It was a catastrophe,” said one worker at the large Intermarché supermarket in the south-west suburb of Issy-les-Moulineaux in Paris. “They pushed the freezers here up to 62C. Everything had to be thrown away. It was such a waste.”
paras.zh: “这是一场灾难，”巴黎伊西莱穆利诺西南郊区的大型 Intermarche 超市的一名工作人员说。 “他们把这里的冰箱温度提高到了 62 摄氏度。所有东西都得扔掉。这太浪费了。”

paras.en: After removing tons of spoiled food, staff at the store worked until almost midnight on Monday to reorder and restock shelves. “Thankfully, we were able to get things almost back to normal the same day,” another shop worker added. “But we had to clear out everything in the freezers.”
paras.zh: 在清除了大量变质的食物后，商店的工作人员周一一直工作到接近午夜，以重新订购和补充货架。 “值得庆幸的是，我们当天就几乎恢复了正常，”另一名商店工作人员补充道。 “但我们必须清理冰箱里的所有东西。”

paras.en: If shop managers first assumed it was an isolated failure, it soon became clear up to 700 stores – including those from the Intermarché, Coopérative U, Carrefour, Leclerc and Monoprix chains along with a number of smaller independent shops – had been victims of a cyber-attack.
paras.zh: 如果商店经理一开始认为这是一次孤立的故障，那么很快就会发现多达 700 家商店——包括 Intermarché、Coopérative U、Carrefour、Leclerc 和 Monoprix 连锁店以及一些较小的独立商店——已经成为网络攻击的受害者。

paras.en: Dominique Schelcher, the president of Coopérative U, said 80 of its 2,000 supermarkets had been targeted. “This is a completely unprecedented, unexpected, and extremely serious attack. In my entire professional career, I’ve never seen anything like it,” the shocked executive told French radio.
paras.zh: Coopérative U 总裁 Dominique Schelcher 表示，其 2000 家超市中有 80 家成为攻击目标。这位震惊的高管告诉法国电台：“这是一次完全前所未有、出乎意料且极其严重的攻击。在我的整个职业生涯中，我从未见过这样的事情。”

paras.en: The Paris public prosecutor’s office immediately opened an investigation into the latest in a series of cyber-attacks that have made France the most hacked country in Europe.
paras.zh: 巴黎检察官办公室立即对一系列网络攻击中的最新事件展开调查，这些攻击使法国成为欧洲遭受黑客攻击最严重的国家。

paras.en: Gérôme Billois, a partner in the cybersecurity and technology company Wavestone, said the hack had the hallmarks of political sabotage.
paras.zh: 网络安全和技术公司 Wavestone 的合伙人杰罗姆·比卢瓦 (Gérôme Billois) 表示，这次黑客攻击具有政治破坏的特征。

paras.en: “The two most feasible scenarios are either it was a group of youngsters or activists who wanted to blow up a few freezers to prove what they could do, or it was a destabilising attack, what we call sabotage, by internal or external state actors,” he said.
paras.zh: “两种最可能的情况是，要么是一群年轻人或活动分子想要炸毁一些冰箱以证明他们能做什么，要么是内部或外部国家行为者发起的破坏稳定的攻击，我们称之为破坏活动，”他说。

paras.en: “As for the attack’s signature, the most likely scenario is still a destabilisation attack – one designed to convey the message to populations that they are not safe, to convey the impression that the government is falling apart, and ultimately to instil fear.
paras.zh: “就袭击的特征而言，最有可能的情况仍然是破坏稳定的袭击——旨在向民众传达他们不安全的信息，传达政府正在崩溃的印象，并最终灌输恐惧。

paras.en: “Currently there are two international actors known for doing this sort of thing: Iran and Russia.”
paras.zh: “目前有两个国际组织因做此类事情而闻名：伊朗和俄罗斯。”

paras.en: The hackers had pirated the controllers supplied by the Danish company Danfoss that controls the freezers and fridges. Most supermarket cold aisles are connected to the internet to allow remote maintenance and alerts for system failures. Initial investigations suggest the hackers disabled alarm systems before tampering with the thermostats, or extended the defrost programme by several hours to avoid triggering alarms.
paras.zh: 黑客盗版了丹麦丹佛斯公司提供的用于控制冰柜和冰箱的控制器。大多数超市冷通道都连接到互联网，以便进行远程维护和系统故障警报。初步调查表明，黑客在篡改恒温器之前禁用了警报系统，或者将除霜程序延长了几个小时以避免触发警报。

paras.en: Danfoss said it had identified security flaws last year and had “long recommended” that customers install updates or replace obsolete unsupported systems. The affected refrigeration units were “running outdated firmware”, it said. In the days following the first wave of attacks, France’s cyber-attack alert centre ANSSI confirmed supermarkets using controllers from two other companies were also targeted.
paras.zh: 丹佛斯表示，它去年发现了安全漏洞，并“长期建议”客户安装更新或更换过时的、不受支持的系统。受影响的制冷装置“运行过时的固件”。在第一波攻击发生后的几天里，法国网络攻击警报中心 ANSSI 证实，使用另外两家公司控制器的超市也成为攻击目标。

paras.en: Marta Rybczyńska, a cybersecurity specialist and researcher, said she had found previous security warnings about old supermarket freezers running out-of-date software and newer models not having firmware updated.
paras.zh: 网络安全专家兼研究员 Marta Rybczyńska 表示，她发现之前有关于旧超市冰柜运行过时软件和较新型号未更新固件的安全警告。

paras.en: “Some of these freezers hadn’t been supported by the manufacturers for several years and there were notices saying they should be replaced. Other freezers were newer but the software hadn’t been updated,” Rybczyńska said.
paras.zh: “其中一些冰柜多年来一直没有得到制造商的支持，并且有通知称它们应该更换。其他冰柜较新，但软件尚未更新，”Rybczyńska 说。

paras.en: “The hackers found these weaknesses and used them.”
paras.zh: “黑客发现了这些弱点并利用了它们。”

paras.en: She added: “Many of the freezers appear to have been running with a default password. The hackers were able to modify or turn off the alerts so the shops only realised when the first person arrived in the morning and saw the damage that had been done.”
paras.zh: 她补充道：“许多冰柜似乎一直在使用默认密码运行。黑客能够修改或关闭警报，因此商店只有在早上第一个人到达并看到所造成的损坏时才意识到。”

paras.en: The most recent French cyber-attack mirrors a similar incident in the US in August when connected fridges and freezers at a dozen military commissaries – on-base food stores – went into unscheduled defrost cycles overnight causing massive food loss.
paras.zh: 最近的法国网络攻击与 8 月份在美国发生的类似事件如出一辙，当时十几个军事小卖部（基地内的食品商店）的联网冰箱和冰柜在一夜之间进入计划外的除霜周期，导致大量粮食损失。

paras.en: France is the most heavily pirated country in Europe by the volume of records exposed by hackers, according to the cybersecurity and risk management company Upguard.
paras.zh: 根据网络安全和风险管理公司 Upguard 的数据，从黑客泄露的记录数量来看，法国是欧洲盗版最严重的国家。

paras.en: In the last three years, hackers have breached France’s health system, France Travail, the government-run jobseekers agency, the National Agency for Identity Documents (ANTS) and most of the big mobile phone companies. This summer, the economy and finance ministry lost the personal and fiscal records of 678,000 taxpayers to a series of cyber-attacks.
paras.zh: 在过去三年中，黑客入侵了法国的医疗系统、France Travail、政府运营的求职机构、国家身份证件局 (ANTS) 以及大多数大型移动电话公司。今年夏天，经济和财政部因一系列网络攻击而丢失了 678,000 名纳税人的个人和财务记录。

paras.en: Billois says France has fallen behind in addressing cybersecurity and has still not adopted the EU’s Cyber Resilience Act (2024) that introduced mandatory security for internet-connected devices.
paras.zh: 比卢瓦表示，法国在解决网络安全方面已经落后，并且仍未通过欧盟的《网络弹性法案》（2024），该法案为互联网连接设备引入了强制安全措施。

paras.en: “It’s a text that’s not political and that everyone agrees on but is delayed because there’s always more urgent legislation or there are quibbles about amendments, and this has been a disaster,” he said.
paras.zh: “这是一个非政治性的文本，每个人都同意，但由于总是有更紧急的立法或对修正案存在争议而被推迟，这是一场灾难，”他说。

paras.en: In the UK, the cyber security and resilience (network and information systems) bill to tackle cyber threats, is wending a similarly tortuous way through parliament. However, it fails to directly cover the food industry.
paras.zh: 在英国，旨在应对网络威胁的网络安全和弹性（网络和信息系统）法案也在议会中以类似的曲折方式获得通过。然而，它未能直接涵盖食品行业。

paras.en: Supermarket boss Schelcher was quick to shift the blame for the attack on to unnamed refrigeration contractors who maintain the cold aisle equipment. “Our supermarkets are not customers of Danfoss,” he told RTL radio.
paras.zh: 超市老板谢尔彻很快将这次袭击的责任归咎于维护冷通道设备的未具名制冷承包商。 “我们的超市不是丹佛斯的客户，”他告诉 RTL 电台。

paras.en: As yet, no individual or group has claimed responsibility for the supermarket cyber-attack; Paris prosecutors have instructed detectives from its anti-cybercrime unit but Billois says finding the hackers will take time.
paras.zh: 到目前为止，还没有任何个人或团体声称对超市网络攻击负责；巴黎检察官已指示其反网络犯罪部门的侦探，但比卢瓦表示，找到黑客需要时间。

paras.en: “It’s possible they’ll be identified eventually, but it could take weeks if not months to be certain because hackers know how to hide their tracks,” Billois said.
paras.zh: 比卢瓦说：“他们最终可能会被识别出来，但可能需要数周甚至数月的时间才能确定，因为黑客知道如何隐藏他们的踪迹。”

paras.en: Rybczyńska added: “Whether it’s possible to trace the hackers depends on their level of capability; if it’s a handful of youngsters, it’s easier because they probably won’t have thought to remove traces. If they are professionals it’s more complicated and will take longer. If they’re in a foreign country, it’ll be extremely difficult.”
paras.zh: Rybczyńska 补充道：“能否追踪到黑客，取决于他们的能力水平；如果是少数年轻人，那就更容易了，因为他们可能不会想到删除痕迹。如果他们是专业人士，那就更复杂，需要更长的时间。如果他们在国外，那就非常困难了。”

paras.en: The total cost of the cyber-attack has yet to be calculated but Thierry Cotillard, the CEO of Intermarché, said losses could run to “tens of millions of euros”, which store companies say is unlikely to be covered by their insurance.
paras.zh: 此次网络攻击的总成本尚未计算，但 Intermarché 首席执行官蒂埃里·歌迪亚 (Thierry Cotillard) 表示，损失可能高达“数千万欧元”，而商店公司表示，他们的保险不太可能承担这些损失。

paras.en: “It’s a bizarre story,” Billois added. “There’s a shared responsibility between the supermarkets, the refrigeration companies who are sub-contractors and who maintain the material, and the software company. We cannot say who is to blame except, of course, the hackers.
paras.zh: “这是一个奇怪的故事，”比卢瓦补充道。 “超市、作为分包商和维护材料的制冷公司以及软件公司之间存在共同责任。我们不能说谁应该受到责备，当然，除了黑客。

paras.en: “But in the end it comes down to freezers connected to the internet without being adequately secured. And that must be a wake-up call to everyone.”
paras.zh: “但最终归根结底是连接到互联网的冰柜没有得到充分的保护。这必须给每个人敲响警钟。”

articles.title: Brazil sees record fall in Amazon deforestation as key election looms

paras.en: Brazil's government says deforestation rates in the country's Amazon and savanna regions have fallen to record lows ahead of a presidential election run-off where the rainforest's future is a key issue.
paras.zh: 巴西政府表示，在总统选举决胜之前，该国亚马逊和稀树草原地区的森林砍伐率已降至历史最低水平，而雨林的未来是一个关键问题。

paras.en: Left-wing President Luiz InÃ¡cio Lula da Silva, when he assumed office three years ago, pledged to end deforestation by 2030 in the Amazon. It had surged under his right-wing predecessor, Jair Bolsonaro.
paras.zh: 左翼总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦三年前上任时承诺，到 2030 年结束亚马逊地区的森林砍伐。在他的右翼前任雅伊尔·博尔索纳罗的领导下，这一数字飙升。

paras.en: On 25 October, Lula will face Bolsonaro's son Flavio in the run-off, with polls suggesting a neck-and-neck race. Flavio is expected to continue his father's policies if he wins, though he has pledged to fight organised crime in the Amazon.
paras.zh: 10 月 25 日，卢拉将在决选中对阵博尔索纳罗的儿子弗拉维奥，民调显示双方势均力敌。如果弗拉维奥获胜，预计他将继续执行父亲的政策，不过他已承诺打击亚马逊地区的有组织犯罪。

paras.en: Satellite data shows that in the year up to July 2026, the deforestation rate fell by 41.8% in the Amazon - the biggest drop since records began in 1988. The fall in the Cerrado, Brazil's savanna region, was 23.8%.
paras.zh: 卫星数据显示，截至2026年7月的一年里，亚马逊地区的森林砍伐率下降了41.8%，这是自1988年有记录以来的最大降幅。巴西稀树草原地区塞拉多的降幅为23.8%。

paras.en: The Amazon rainforest - the world's largest - is a crucial buffer in the global fight against climate change and 60% of it is located in Brazil.
paras.zh: 世界上最大的亚马逊雨林是全球应对气候变化的重要缓冲地带，其中 60% 位于巴西。

paras.en: Jair Bolsonaro promoted mining in indigenous lands in the Amazon and forest clearances soared at the same time as resources to protect the forest were cut.
paras.zh: 贾尔·博尔索纳罗推动了亚马逊地区土著土地的采矿业，森林砍伐量猛增，同时保护森林的资源也被砍伐。

paras.en: During Bolsonaro's presidency from 2019 to 2022, the Amazon lost nearly 60% more in forest lands compared to the previous four years, AFP news agency reported, citing official data.
paras.zh: 据法新社援引官方数据报道，在博尔索纳罗 2019 年至 2022 年担任总统期间，亚马逊地区的林地比前四年增加了近 60%。

paras.en: Lula reversed Jair Bolsonaro's policies and saw deforestation rates drop to a six-year low during his first year in office. Lula tightened up environmental monitoring and penalties for illegal logging.
paras.zh: 卢拉推翻了雅伊尔·博尔索纳罗的政策，在他执政的第一年里，森林砍伐率降至六年来的最低点。卢拉加强了环境监测和对非法采伐的处罚。

paras.en: "Our goal is to achieve zero illegal deforestation by 2030," he said in a post on X on Friday.
paras.zh: “我们的目标是到 2030 年实现零非法砍伐森林，”他周五在 X 上发帖称。

paras.en: Tropical rainforests like the Amazon are home to millions of species. In a healthy state they absorb vast quantities of planet-warming carbon dioxide, helping to keep the Earth cool.
paras.zh: 像亚马逊这样的热带雨林是数百万物种的家园。在健康状态下，它们吸收大量导致地球变暖的二氧化碳，帮助地球保持凉爽。

paras.en: But they have come under increasing pressure from decades of deliberate land clearance for agriculture and logging, as well as climate change, which scientists warn can create conditions for wildfires.
paras.zh: 但几十年来，为了农业和伐木而故意开垦土地，以及气候变化，他们面临着越来越大的压力，科学家警告说，气候变化可能为野火创造条件。

paras.en: Brazil's Environment Minister, Joao Paulo Capobianco, described the decline in Amazon deforestation as "absolutely stratospheric".
paras.zh: 巴西环境部长若昂·保罗·卡波比安科 (Joao Paulo Capobianco) 将亚马逊森林砍伐的减少描述为“绝对是平流层”。

paras.en: It is a "historic achievement" for Brazil, said Marcio Astrini, executive secretary at climate advocacy group Observatorio do Clima.
paras.zh: 气候倡导组织气候观察组织执行秘书马西奥·阿斯特里尼表示，这对巴西来说是一项“历史性成就”。

paras.en: It shows that "with political will, it is possible to curb deforestation and greenhouse gas emissions", Astrini said.
paras.zh: 阿斯特里尼说，这表明“只要有政治意愿，就有可能遏制森林砍伐和温室气体排放”。

articles.title: Trump waives several Russia sanctions as new US law takes effect

paras.en: US President Donald Trump has used his presidential authority to block numerous sanctions on Russia that were recently passed by the US Congress in an effort to punish the country for its war on Ukraine.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普利用其总统权力阻止了美国国会最近通过的多项针对俄罗斯的制裁措施，旨在惩罚该国对乌克兰的战争。

paras.en: In an executive order on Friday night, Trump said that it is in the US "national interests" to withhold some of the sanctions. Trump signed the sanctions bill into law in September, and it was due to take effect on Sunday.
paras.zh: 特朗普在周五晚上的一份行政命令中表示，取消部分制裁符合美国的“国家利益”。特朗普于 9 月签署了制裁法案，使其成为法律，该法案将于周日生效。

paras.en: It comes days after Trump said the US would import Russian diesel in an effort to bring down US energy prices before the midterm elections in November, which will decide which party controls Congress.
paras.zh: 几天前，特朗普表示，美国将进口俄罗斯柴油，以在 11 月中期选举之前压低美国能源价格，中期选举将决定哪个政党控制国会。

paras.en: The plan shocked lawmakers, and has triggered a bipartisan backlash.
paras.zh: 该计划震惊了立法者，并引发了两党的强烈反对。

paras.en: The US sanctions law is named for the late Republican South Carolina Senator Lindsey Graham, who was one of Ukraine's staunchest defenders in Washington before his death on 11 July.
paras.zh: 美国制裁法以已故南卡罗来纳州共和党参议员林赛·格雷厄姆 (Lindsey Graham) 的名字命名，他于 7 月 11 日去世前是华盛顿最坚定的乌克兰捍卫者之一。

paras.en: The law took aim at Russian's economy, and gave Trump broad powers to levy tariffs of up to 100% on the top five purchasers of Russian oil and gas â most significantly China and India.
paras.zh: 该法律针对的是俄罗斯经济，并赋予特朗普广泛的权力，可以对俄罗斯石油和天然气的前五名购买国（尤其是中国和印度）征收高达 100% 的关税。

paras.en: Additionally, the law includes sanctions against Russian President Vladimir Putin, senior figures within the Russian government as well as banks and other financial institutions and Russia's "shadow fleet" of tankers used to circumvent existing sanctions.
paras.zh: 此外，该法律还包括对俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京、俄罗斯政府高级官员、银行和其他金融机构以及俄罗斯用于规避现有制裁的“影子油轮舰队”的制裁。

paras.en: On Thursday, a bipartisan group of 20 US lawmakers issued a letter calling on Trump to respect the new law, which is due to take effect on 18 October.
paras.zh: 周四，由 20 名美国议员组成的两党团体发表了一封信，呼吁特朗普尊重将于 10 月 18 日生效的新法律。

paras.en: The lawmakers thanked Trump for signing the sanctions bill, and urged his "full and faithful implementation" of the law.
paras.zh: 议员们感谢特朗普签署制裁法案，并敦促他“全面、忠实地执行”该法律。

paras.en: The lawmakers said it would be "decisive in forcing Putin to take peace talks seriously" and called on the Trump administration "to apply the Graham law's sanctions to their fullest extent and without delay".
paras.zh: 议员们表示，这将“对迫使普京认真对待和谈具有决定性作用”，并呼吁特朗普政府“毫不拖延地最大限度地实施格雷厄姆法的制裁”。

paras.en: Last week, Trump announced that he had held a phone call with Putin, and had agreed to purchase diesel from Moscow.
paras.zh: 上周，特朗普宣布他已与普京通电话，并同意从莫斯科购买柴油。

paras.en: US allies criticised the move, anxious that it could help Russia in its war effort.
paras.zh: 美国盟友批评此举，担心这可能有助于俄罗斯的战争努力。

paras.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky called the deal a gift to Putin that amounts to "an investment in a war that must be ended".
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统泽伦斯基称该协议是给普京的一份礼物，相当于“对一场必须结束的战争的投资”。

articles.title: Three men jailed for 158 years each for murdering Australian and US surfers in Mexico

paras.en: A Mexican judge has sentenced three men convicted of murdering Australian brothers Jake and Callum Robinson, and their US friend Carter Rhoad to 158 years and nine months in jail each.
paras.zh: 一名墨西哥法官判处三名谋杀澳大利亚兄弟杰克·罗宾逊和卡勒姆·罗宾逊以及他们的美国朋友卡特·罗德的男子每人 158 年零 9 个月监禁。

paras.en: The Robinsons and Rhoad were killed in an apparent botched robbery of their truck on a secluded beach in Baja California in 2024 while they were on a surfing trip, the court heard during the trial.
paras.zh: 法庭在庭审期间获悉，2024 年，罗宾逊夫妇和罗德夫妇在下加利福尼亚州一处僻静的海滩上冲浪时，他们的卡车遭到明显拙劣的抢劫，结果被杀。

paras.en: The murders sent shockwaves around the world, particularly in Australia, as the area is usually safe from the violence seen in other parts of Mexico.
paras.zh: 这些谋杀案在世界各地引起了震动，特别是在澳大利亚，因为该地区通常不会发生墨西哥其他地区发生的暴力事件。

paras.en: The guilty verdict was handed down last week. Debra Robinson, the brothers' mother, told the courtroom that her sons' murders had taken "the future we had imagined with them".
paras.zh: 有罪判决于上周作出。兄弟俩的母亲黛布拉·罗宾逊 (Debra Robinson) 在法庭上表示，她儿子的谋杀夺走了“我们对他们想象的未来”。

paras.en: The convicted killers' full names could not be given for legal reasons, and they were only identified as JesÃºs Gerardo, Irineo Francisco and Ãngel JesÃºs.
paras.zh: 由于法律原因，被定罪的凶手的全名无法透露，他们只被确认为杰斯·杰拉尔多 (Jesús Gerardo)、伊里内奥·弗朗西斯科 (Irineo Francisco) 和安格尔·杰斯 (Angel Jesús)。

paras.en: In November last year, the girlfriend of the alleged ringleader, JesÃºs Gerardo (alias "El Kekas"), was sentenced in a separate trial to 20 years in prison. She had admitted to involvement in the robbery.
paras.zh: 去年 11 月，涉嫌头目的女友 Jesús Gerardo（别名“El Kekas”）在另一项审判中被判处 20 年监禁。她承认参与了这起抢劫案。

paras.en: The court heard that the bodies of the victims were found dumped down a well with gunshot wounds to their heads.
paras.zh: 法庭获悉，受害者的尸体被发现被扔进一口井里，头部受枪伤。

paras.en: At the time, the murders shocked locals and tourists in the beach town of Ensenada who were disturbed at the apparent ease and sheer pointlessness of the killings.
paras.zh: 当时，这起谋杀案震惊了海滨小镇恩塞纳达的当地人和游客，他们对这些看似轻松且毫无意义的杀戮感到不安。

paras.en: Ensenada has a reputation as a welcoming spot for surfers, but the chilling murders revealed how commonplace such extreme violence remains in Mexico.
paras.zh: 恩塞纳达被誉为冲浪者的好去处，但令人毛骨悚然的谋杀案表明，这种极端暴力行为在墨西哥仍然司空见惯。

paras.en: The only explanation the authorities were able to give was that the surfers - all in their early 30s - had ultimately been murdered for being in the wrong place at the wrong time.
paras.zh: 当局能够给出的唯一解释是，这些冲浪者——全部三十岁出头——最终因在错误的时间出现在错误的地点而被谋杀。

paras.en: Their killings happened barely 36 hours after they crossed into Mexico from the US. Their bodies, however, were not found for another week, when their families were able to identify them.
paras.zh: 他们从美国进入墨西哥后仅 36 小时就被杀了。然而，他们的尸体又过了一周才被发现，直到他们的家人才辨认出他们的身份。

paras.en: Local surfers also called for greater security for residents and visiting tourists, citing other recent examples of violence in the state. Tourism is a key part of the regional economy in Baja California.
paras.zh: 当地冲浪者还援引该州最近发生的其他暴力事件，呼吁加强居民和来访游客的安全。旅游业是下加利福尼亚州区域经济的重要组成部分。

articles.title: Carlisle Launches EL121 Disc Brakes for Improved Performance and Wear Life

paras.en: Carlisle Launches EL121 Disc Brakes for Improved Performance and Wear Life

(MEDINA, OH, September 12, 2023) – Carlisle Brake & Friction is excited to announce the launch of EL121 Disc Brake Pads for mine haul truck applications. The new product series will be named Extended Life, or the EL Series, and EL121 will be the first friction formulation of the series to launch.

Carlisle’s EL121 Series friction material nearly doubles the service life of front-axle, mine haul truck brake pads. The result is increased equipment uptime, and reduced maintenance costs when utilizing the OEM calipers and rotors.

Autonomous haul trucks experience higher pad temperatures, which drive elevated pad wear from increased braking cycles as the retarder and the service brake are applied. EL121 features a highly wear-resistant friction material blend that provides extended brake pad life with consistent and fade-resistant braking performance. EL121 is the ideal solution for today’s autonomous mine haul trucks (may also be used in manned mine haul trucks for increased performance and longevity).

“We understand that mine operators need to keep their haul trucks on the job and not in the shop for brake service. Our latest innovation allows for up to double the service life of the front-axle mine haul truck brake pads and are a will-fit replacement to existing OEM pads. These were thoroughly lab tested as well as field tested on Komatsu 830E-1 trucks,” said Ron Ratell, Product Line Director Friction Products at Carlisle Brake & Friction.

EL121 friction has been dyno tested to replicate the application and is proven to deliver an innovative, high-energy material to meet market needs. EL121 disc brake pads also feature an industry-proven mechanical retention system with backing plate technology designed for superior bonding and durability, capable of withstanding abusive conditions in even the harshest Off-Highway environments.

Carlisle’s EL121 Series disc brake pads are available now through authorized Carlisle dealers and distributors. To learn more, visit https://www.carlislecbf.com/products/brake-friction/disc-brake-pads/off-highway-disc-brake-pads/el. To locate an authorized Carlisle dealer near you, search our online distributor listing https://www.carlislecbf.com/support/find-a-distributor.

Carlisle Brake & Friction is a globally recognized leader in the development and manufacture of highly innovative brake and friction system solutions to service a diverse range of motion control applications. The comprehensive nature of Carlisle’s brake system expertise includes hydraulic control products, industrial brake assemblies, wet and dry friction material for brake, clutch, and transmission applications as well as aftermarket replacement products. Our full-system product offering, supported by our industry-experience staff of experts, provides our customers with brake system solutions that set them apart from their competition. www.carlislecbf.com

paras.en: The FutureTech Studio will return to the 2026 SEMA Show with more than 20 vehicles and a three-day education program highlighting technologies changing how automotive aftermarket products are designed, developed and brought to market. Topics include advanced powertrains and fuels, artificial intelligence, automated driving technologies and emerging product-development tools.

Located in Central Hall, booth no. 24401, FutureTech Studio will feature vehicles showcasing alternative fuels and EV powertrains, a FutureTech Live Education Stage offering 21 30-minute microlearning sessions across three days and product displays demonstrating solutions to help manufacturers get products to market faster.

“FutureTech Studio is designed to show industry professionals both where automotive technology stands today and where it’s headed, helping attendees evaluate emerging solutions, understand their business implications and identify opportunities to remain competitive,” said Jim Moore, vice president of OEM and product development for SEMA. “Attendees can expect a connected, hands-on environment where they can see technologies up close, talk with experts and experience how innovations are shaping the industry’s future.”

articles.title: INDASA, Save the Rhino International Join Forces
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: INDASA announced it has partnered with Save the Rhino International, a UK-registered charity working to safeguard rhino species and their landscapes. The partnership brings together two organizations connected by a shared symbol: the rhino.

For INDASA, the Rhyno has represented strength, resilience and performance for decades. For Save the Rhino International, the vision is a future where all five rhino species thrive in the wild. The idea is straightforward: the symbol that has represented INDASA for decades should also help protect the species behind it.

At the center of the initiative are INDASA’s Rhynogrip and Rhynostick White Line, both in 150mm and in 125mm. Throughout the campaign, these products will feature bespoke packaging designed to reflect INDASA’s commitment to the partnership with Save the Rhino International and to carry the conservation message to markets around the world.

The special-edition packaging becomes a visible platform for the conservation cause, placing it in the hands of the professionals who use these products every day. Every package sold also contributes directly to rhino conservation, creating a clear connection between a professional-use product and a global environmental cause.

Through its products, packaging, digital communication and international network, INDASA aims to raise awareness of rhino conservation beyond traditional environmental audiences, reaching the body shops and distributors where the cause has never been addressed before.

Save the Rhino International works in partnership with conservation organizations, governments and local communities to conserve rhinos and their landscapes. These collaborations bring together knowledge, expertise and resources to support evidence-based conservation, address the challenges facing rhino populations and secure their long-term recovery.

Through this partnership, INDASA is contributing to those ongoing projects and giving the conservation message a route into an industry outside the organization’s usual reach. The campaign gives industry professionals a way into the cause: by acquiring the products they already use in their surface preparation activities, they contribute to conservation efforts, creating a direct connection between product, people and purpose.

Running for one year, the campaign connects every package sold with a direct contribution to Save the Rhino International’s conservation work. For every campaign box sold, INDASA will donate €0.03 directly to the organization.

The campaign identity captures the connection at the heart of the partnership. “By The Rhyno” represents the means: the strength and reach of INDASA’s own symbol, put behind the cause. “For the Rhino” represents the purpose: raising awareness and supporting the conservation of rhinos and their natural habitats.

The donation matters. So does the attention it brings: rhinos placed in front of professionals who would otherwise never come across the cause, and the reminder that a routine purchase can be part of protecting a species.

articles.title: Takata airbag recall: NHTSA says status of 9% unconfirmed
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) says it “cannot confirm the status” of the remaining 9% of more than 67 million recalled Takata airbags, or whether they remain on U.S. roads.
NHTSA told Repairer Driven News that according to its latest 2024 completion-rate estimates, 91% of the affected airbags had been replaced or were otherwise accounted for.

The Takata airbag inflator recall is the largest safety recall in automotive history and spans worldwide. Issues first came to light in 2008. Vehicles across more than 30 brands are equipped with the airbags, according to NHTSA.
NHTSA says the airbags have killed 28 people and caused at least 400 injuries in the U.S. It linked the 28th death to an incident that occurred in Alabama involving a Honda vehicle.

“NHTSA cannot confirm the status of the remaining 9% or if they remain on U.S. roads,” a NHTSA spokesperson told Repairer Driven News. “NHTSA encourages everyone to check for open recalls at nhtsa.gov or by downloading our SaferCar app. Anyone with an open Takata recall should follow any manufacturer warnings and call their vehicle’s dealership immediately to schedule a free repair.”

The chart below shows the net percentage of airbags remaining for replacement for priority groups 1–12. “Net” refers to the percent remaining from the total airbags count, according to NHTSA. NHTSA includes these groups because vehicle manufacturers have submitted verifiable underlying data.

The chart above specifies the percentage of dispositioned airbags, as approved by NHTSA, including stolen and scrapped vehicles and those exported from the U.S. jurisdiction, according to NHTSA. It also includes vehicles with aftermarket modifications, degraded to the point that the recall remedy cannot be completed, and those to which owners have been nonresponsive to or have affirmatively refused the recall remedy outreach.

The data in this chart begins in 2022 when NHTSA added several reporting categories: nonresponsive, affirmative refusal, aftermarket modification, and vehicle degradation. NHTSA must receive a request before a vehicle manufacturer can submit to these categories. NHTSA notes that not all vehicle manufacturers have been approved for or have requested inclusion in the categories.

Takata, a bankrupt parts supplier, was responsible for manufacturing airbag canisters in defective airbag inflators that can explode and spray sharp metal fragments toward the driver and passengers, comparable to shrapnel from an exploding grenade, which has caused severe injuries and deaths.

According to the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA), propellant in the inflators breaks down after long-term exposure to high temperature fluctuations and humidity. This can cause the propellant to burn too quickly, creating too much pressure and leading to explosions.

As of Aug. 21, Honda says it has voluntarily removed over 535,000 inflators from salvage yards, and the effort continues. The OEM says it has also asked major online auction sites to prohibit and stop any sales of the affected airbags.
A separate group of defective Takata airbags was recalled in late 2019. According to NHTSA, unlike the airbag inflators in the larger Takata recalls, this recall involves non-azide driver inflators.
According to the latest Carfax data, 4.7 million vehicles equipped with recalled Takata airbags remain in the U.S.
Carfax says the number of vehicles on the road with the Takata airbags has dropped 20% from 6 million in 2024.

“Many automakers are working to find owners of vehicles that still have Takata airbags and finally get those airbags replaced,” Carfax states in its September recall tracker report. “Some are even sending teams out across the country to locate affected owners and provide help.

“Despite the drop in affected vehicles, nearly 5 million still need those Takata airbags replaced, and as they get older, they’re more likely to continue to change hands, which makes tracking down the owners more difficult. And some of those vehicles even have ‘do not drive’ orders.”

articles.title: CCC announces its acquisition by GTCR, Elliott
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: CCC Intelligent Solutions Holdings announced Thursday that a consortium of private investment firms, led by GTCR and including Elliott Investment Management, will acquire it in an all-cash transaction with an enterprise value of $6.1 billion.
Until the transaction closes, CCC will remain publicly traded and continue operating as an independent company, according to a CCC press release.

“The transaction is not subject to a financing condition,” the release states. “Upon completion of the transaction, CCC will become a privately held company, and its common stock will no longer be listed on the Nasdaq.”
Githesh Ramamurthy, CCC’s chairman and CEO, says Thursday’s announcement “follows a thorough review of strategic options with assistance from our financial and legal advisors.”

The release states that CCC’s Board of Directors approved the transaction, which is expected to close in Q1 2027, subject to customary closing conditions, including the receipt of required regulatory approvals and CCC stockholder approval.

“Our Board of Directors is confident this transaction recognizes the strength of the business our team has built while delivering immediate and premium cash value to our stockholders,” said Ramamurthy.

Under the terms of a definitive agreement, CCC stockholders will receive $7.75 in cash for each share of CCC common stock, representing a premium of 44% to CCC’s unaffected closing stock price on July 9, 2026, and a premium of 59% to the 30-day average price as of July 9, 2026.

A press release announcing the acquisition notes that July 9 was the last trading day before media speculation of CCC’s potential sale. At the time, Reuters reported that CCC was “exploring a sale of the company, according to three people familiar with the matter.”
The article stated: “The Chicago-based company has hired Morgan Stanley to advise on a sale process and has reached out to prospective buyers, including private equity firms, the sources said.”
In August, Seeking Alpha, Bloomberg News, and Reuters reported that private equity firms and Copart were reportedly interested in buying CCC.
At the time Repairer Driven News reached out to CCC for comment on the reported interest. A company spokesperson responded, “CCC doesn’t comment on rumors and speculation.”
Now, Ramamurthy says that with the experience and resources GTCR and Elliot provide, CCC will continue to build on its momentum and extend its leadership.

“Throughout CCC’s history, we have helped customers navigate growing complexity and achieve better outcomes through technology and innovation,” he said. “Together, we will accelerate the AI and agentic capabilities our customers want from us, expand the network at the center of our platform, and continue to develop and build our world-class team. I am deeply grateful to our employees for their dedication and commitment to our customers, and I am excited for all that we will accomplish together in this next chapter.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: He shared similar commentary to a Facebook post by CCC announcing the sale.

A Reuters article published after the CCC announcement noted that “earlier this year, the company faced investor concerns over slowing growth, softer claims volumes and a slower-than-expected rollout of some newer software products, which had weighed on its share price.” Meanwhile, the acquiring firms have expressed confidence in CCC’s underlying business and its opportunities for future growth, particularly through artificial intelligence.

When Repairer Driven News asked CCC for comment on its reasoning for the acquisition, CCC reiterated that its Board of Directors approved the transaction and said it “delivers immediate and certain value to shareholders at a significant premium to the unaffected share price.”

“CCC remains a strong business,” a CCC spokesperson said. “Our Board of Directors is confident this transaction recognizes the strength of the business our team has built while delivering immediate and premium cash value to our stockholders. Beyond today’s announcement and related SEC filings, we do not have additional information to share at this time.”
CCC went public in 2021 after announcing its owners at the time, and a Dragoneer Investment Group spinoff had agreed to a merger and subsequent listing of shares on the New York Stock Exchange.

Private equity firm Advent, which owned the majority of CCC at the time, would continue to hold most of the shares once CCC went public. Reuters previously reported that Advent “fully exited its investment in 2025 through a series of secondary share offerings, including the sale of its remaining stake in November.”

On Thursday, Mark Anderson, GTCR media and telecommunications managing director and head of technology, said the PE firm has followed CCC for years and believes it’s “uniquely positioned to support their customers as they increasingly adopt AI solutions to improve decision-making and efficiency across the claims and repair lifecycle.”

“We look forward to partnering with Githesh and the talented CCC team to support continued investment in product innovation and AI capabilities, expand the company’s offerings and build long-term value,” he said. “Our focus will be on helping CCC deliver better outcomes for its customers while supporting CCC’s next phase of growth.”

David Kerko, Elliott’s head of global private equity, added: “We have [a] strong belief in CCC’s position as the trusted third party at the center of the automotive insurance and repair industry. CCC’s role within the large ecosystem of insurers, repair facilities, automakers and parts suppliers creates strong data advantages and network benefits for their more than 35,000 customers. We believe these advantages make CCC a highly durable franchise in vertical software – which AI will only make more valuable as CCC delivers the next generation of capabilities to its customers.”

Morgan Stanley & Co. is serving as financial advisor in the transaction. Kirkland & Ellis is serving as legal counsel, and Joele Frank, with Wilkinson Brimmer Katcher, is serving as strategic communications advisor to CCC.

J.P. Morgan is serving as lead financial advisor to GTCR and lead arranger of committed financing for the transaction. Citi is also serving as financial advisor and participating in the committed financing. Simpson, Thacher & Bartlett is serving as GTCR’s legal counsel. Gibson, Dunn & Crutcher and Debevoise & Plimpton are serving as Elliott’s legal counsel.
