articles.title: I lost half my right lung to cancer. Pope Leo's diagnosis gives me hope

paras.en: When Pope Leo told the crowd in St. Peter's Square on Sunday that doctors had found "a small, localized nodule" in his lung, the reassurances came fast. Most nodules are benign, media medical experts quickly said. Probably nothing to worry about.

I heard the same reassurances about my own lung not long ago. They were wrong then, and on Tuesday the Vatican confirmed they were wrong now. The nodule was adenocarcinoma, lung cancer. Surgeons removed the lower lobe of the Holy Father's right lung through a few small incisions, guided by a camera rather than an open chest, and he was back in his room the same afternoon.

That is almost exactly what happened to me. Half of my right lung was removed just 12 months ago, and I was running just four weeks after that. So, my first reaction when I heard the pope's diagnosis was not dread. It was hope.

I was 43, a mother of four, a daily runner, and the daughter of a lung doctor. The morning I learned I had lung cancer, I had already completed a six-mile run without a hint that anything was wrong. I had no symptoms. Under current guidelines, I was not supposed to be at risk, and I did not qualify for screening.

My diagnosis came from a scan I chose, not from a symptom. My husband and I have always leaned toward proactive testing, and at his urging I scheduled what I assumed would be a baseline full-body scan, paid for out of pocket. It showed a 3.8-centimeter nodule on my right lung. Initial advice from the reading radiologist recommended to follow-up if symptoms occurred. But with a father as a lung doctor and a friend as a lung radiologist, they pushed me to follow up sooner. The new low dose CT of my chest showed the mass had grown in just two months. But that scan led to a diagnosis of stage 1B lung cancer and, like the pope, to surgery to remove it. Still, no symptoms ever appeared.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Four weeks to the day after my operation, I was on a plane. I was running again within weeks. Caught early and handled by a skilled medical team and a surgeon who does this every day, lung cancer is not a death sentence. It is a survivable disease, a fixable problem. If the pope keeps his November trip to South America, he will board that plane about as far out from surgery as I was.

So the gloom I see in my text threads with Catholic friends this week is misplaced. What should worry Americans is something else entirely. The pope's cancer was found during a routine checkup. Mine was found because I paid for a scan no one recommended. Most Americans get neither.

Lung cancer is the leading cause of cancer death in the United States and one of the most expensive cancers to treat, because it is usually found late. Current guidelines recommend screening only for adults ages 50 to 80 with a heavy smoking history. Fewer than one in five people who qualify ever get the scan. And nearly two-thirds of people diagnosed with lung cancer would not have qualified at all. I am one of them.

Stage at diagnosis is the strongest predictor of both survival and cost. Found at stage I, five-year survival can exceed 90%. Yet most cases are still found after the disease has spread, when curative treatment becomes unlikely.

There is a fix on the table. The Saving Health by Identifying Risk for Americans (SHIRA) Act, a draft bill now circulating in the White House, HHS and Congress, would make lung cancer screening free to the patient under Medicare — no copay, no deductible. It would cover veterans exposed to burn pits, guarantee a first scan to cancer survivors and those with a family history, and require Medicare to modernize who counts as "high risk" so that never-smokers, like me, stop being invisible. It builds a path toward age-based screening after 40, the way we already screen for breast and colorectal cancer.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: I was fortunate. A preventive scan, a persistent friend and father, and an early diagnosis gave me a future I might not otherwise have had. The pope was fortunate too: a routine check found his cancer before he felt a thing. Luck should not decide who survives lung cancer. Screening policy should.
I am praying for the pope this week, and I am confident. I would like every American to have the same reason for confidence he does.

articles.title: ‘Tough to watch, impossible to ignore’: reviewers on NAZA documentary
articles.author: Sammy Gecsoyler

paras.en: Critics around the world have hailed the award-winning documentary NAZA as a “brilliant and harrowing” film that is “impossible to ignore”.

NAZA, which is produced by the Guardian and details Israel’s mass killing of civilians in Gaza, was released in UK cinemas this week and will be shown in more than 50 countries. As well as its global cinema releases, NAZA will be available free on the Guardian’s website from late November.
The investigative documentary, which contains 24 interviews with Israeli military insiders speaking anonymously on the rooftops of Tel Aviv at night, has received widespread praise.

In a five-star review, the Financial Times’s Danny Leigh says that as a piece of cinema, “journalism and film-making brilliantly entwine”. The Times calls the film “hugely provocative and a disturbing account” of Israel’s mass killing of civilians in Gaza, and the Irish Times brands NAZA an “essential record of engineered nightmare”. In a four-star review, the Guardian’s Peter Bradshaw says the “anguish of Gaza is brought into pin-sharp focus”.

British Vogue calls NAZA a “brilliant and harrowing film” that outlines the “restrained, meticulous, bone-chilling depiction of the progressive erasure of Gaza”. The magazine says the film “feels destined to become an enduring historical document, one which will and should be seen by generations to come”.

Time Out magazine says NAZA “puts together a restrained, intelligent, articulate, precise and utterly damning case against Israel’s actions in Gaza and their ongoing actions through the region. As a work of cinema, it is exemplary. As a work of journalism, it is inarguable. As a document, it is an indictment.”

The New York Times makes the film a “critic’s choice” and calls NAZA a “haunting” documentary that is “tough to watch, and impossible to ignore”. The Los Angeles Times says NAZA is a “stone-cold frightening” film that “burns the conscience”. And in New York magazine, it is described as “one of the most important films of our time”.

The Hollywood Reporter praises NAZA as a “sober and thoroughly documented bombshell of an exposé” that “leaves one with a deadening feeling, as if humanity may have lost all hope”. The Toronto Star says “NAZA is heartbreaking but essential viewing, questioning the systems that cause and quantify civilian death in modern warfare”.

The Spanish outlet El Mundo hailed NAZA as “the film of our time, a superb, electrifying, and devastating documentary about the systematic model of annihilation of the Palestinian people” that ultimately “points the finger at us. At night, in silence.”

The French newspaper Le Monde says the film “has the effect of an uppercut that leaves the viewer stunned”, while the Danish culture magazine Soundvenue calls NAZA a “soul-crushing testimony to the genocide in Gaza” that is an “example of how the world increasingly seems like a dystopia”.

The United Arab Emirates’ state-owned newspaper the National calls NAZA a “sickeningly tough film to watch”, and an editorial in the Israeli-outlet Haaretz says the film is “trying to force Israelis to confront what they already know: that Israel’s conduct of the war in Gaza has left a black stain”.

When the film opened in Italy last month, it topped the charts. The Italian newspaper Corriere della Sera says NAZA lasts “only 80 minutes, but no more is needed: the ‘scientific’ coldness with which the interviewees reconstruct how they are destroying Gaza is something unforgettable”.

The film contains 24 interviews with Israeli military insiders who detail how an AI-assisted apparatus of mass surveillance was activated during the Gaza war, revealing the systems that were used to target Hamas operatives in the knowledge that large numbers of Palestinian civilians would also die.

Various organisations, including the UN, Amnesty International, B’Tselem and Physicians for Human Rights, the latter two of which are Israeli-based, have said Israel is committing genocide against Palestinians in Gaza.
The film premiered at the Venice film festival, where it was received a 25-minute standing ovation – a festival record. The documentary went on to win the special jury prize.

articles.title: Pope has called Putin to request supplies and evacuation for occupied city of Oleshky – Europe live
articles.author: Jakub Krupa

paras.en: Pope Leo urges Russia's Putin to allow first aid into Russian-occupied city, allow evacuation

The Vatican says Pope Leo – still in hospital after his lung surgery earlier this week – spoke with Russian president Vladimir Putin this afternoon,expressing his grave concern for the humanitarian situation in the occupied city of Oleshky.
He asked Putin to allow entry of first aid and food supplies and to permit a voluntary evacuation of the civil population in the town.
“Today, His Holiness Pope Leo XIV spoke by telephone with His Excellency Mr Vladimir Rutin, President of the Russian Federation.

During the conversation, the Holy Father expressed his deep concern shout the grave humanitarian situation in the city of Oleshky, in the Kherson region, and called for a ceasefire to allow the delivery of food and medical assistance, and the voluntary and safe evacuation of the civilian population.
Finally, the Holy Father reaffirmed the Holy See’s commitment to promoting dialogue and peace. “
Kremlin says Putin told he is supportive of ideas to help civilians in Oleshky
For what it’s worth, the Kremlin says that Vladimir Putin supported Pope Leo’s initiative.
“The Vatican’s intention to help create the conditions necessary to ensure the safety of the town’s population and to organise vital supplies has been supported,” the Kremlin said in a statement.
“It has been agreed to cooperate on this matter.”
But it stressed that Putin “offered a comprehensive explanation of the Kyiv regime’s responsibility for the difficult humanitarian situation there.”
Pope Leo urges Russia's Putin to allow first aid into Russian-occupied city, allow evacuation

The Vatican says Pope Leo – still in hospital after his lung surgery earlier this week – spoke with Russian president Vladimir Putin this afternoon,expressing his grave concern for the humanitarian situation in the occupied city of Oleshky.
He asked Putin to allow entry of first aid and food supplies and to permit a voluntary evacuation of the civil population in the town.
“Today, His Holiness Pope Leo XIV spoke by telephone with His Excellency Mr Vladimir Rutin, President of the Russian Federation.

During the conversation, the Holy Father expressed his deep concern shout the grave humanitarian situation in the city of Oleshky, in the Kherson region, and called for a ceasefire to allow the delivery of food and medical assistance, and the voluntary and safe evacuation of the civilian population.
Finally, the Holy Father reaffirmed the Holy See’s commitment to promoting dialogue and peace. “
Merz stresses urgency of getting political agreement on EU budget

Finally, Merz gets another question on the next EU budget and competing interests, claims and demands from various countries, including from Marine le Pen, who leads the polls ahead of next year’s presidential elections in France.

Merz says it has been a good practice to agree the financial deal “roughly a year before” it kicks in, and says this time is needed to prepare its implementation at the technical level – more so than political discussions linked to various elections.
He is off to Bonn next I think, where he is expected to attend a big meeting of the youth arm of his CDU party as he continues to face domestic criticism over his style of governance.
Merz gets asked if he had any words of advice for Zelenskyy.
He says he wouldn’t offer any advice publicly as the two talk regularly to each other.
He says he is aware that the Americans have other interests as well, but the Russian invasion on Ukraine is “an assault on the political order across all of Europe.”
He also takes note of Russia’s own actions to place European companies in Russia under state-mandated administration, and says the government will examine these cases closely.
But he says the leaders also discuss a further restrictions on “a very large number of visas still being issued to Russian citizens travelling to the EU.”
“There is certainly room for us to restrict this type of travel … If Russia chooses to respond, we will be ready with a reply,” he says.
He also gets a question on migration, and he says this discussion is still ongoing – but reveals that other leaders, including the Greek PM, noted “enormous progress” made in recent years.
Back to the question of further financial support to Ukraine, he says no decision has been made on the form in which this could be offered.
Merz backs Ukraine's strikes on Russia's communications, energy infrastructure in response to attacks
Merz gets asked about the fallout between Zelenskyy and Trump, and what can be done about it.
He says he is in regular contact with Trump by phone, and will see him in person “by December at the latest.”
But focuses on saying that he sees “no willingness on the Russian side to end this war,” with all indications actually going in the opposite direction as “the escalation continues.”

“Against this backdrop, I believe it is appropriate, logical, and understandable for Ukraine to strike targets within Russia that hinder the war effort of the Russian government and the Russian army – including both communication and energy supply systems.”
He says that’s “the only means Ukraine has to signal to Russia that it is prepared to defend itself.”
'Broad consensus' to keep supporting Ukraine, but details on funding yet to be agreed, Merz says
Germany’s Merz gets asked about the discussion with Zelenskyy and his request for more money for Ukraine.
He says it was more of a discussion with no formal decisions, but says “we are all very concerned about the situation in Ukraine.”

He says there is “a broad consensus” to keep supporting Ukraine “through the winter and into the coming year,” with the commission “assessing the financial requirements,” acknowledging the €90bn loan from last year may not be enough.
He says further discussions on this are expected in November and December.
'Significant differences' on EU budget, but broad support for new trade instrument, new proposals for automotive industry, Merz says
German chancellor Friedrich Merz is the first national leader to leave the room, and he’s now briefing reporters on today’s talks.
He begins by saying the talks are “not quite finished yet,” but gives a bit of a readout from the discussions.

He says the leaders discussed the issue dear to his heart, namely how to improve the bloc’s competitiveness, and agreed that “only an economically strong and sovereign Europe can hold its own in today’s world.”
He says the leaders will meet to discuss in again in early February.

He also says there was “unanimous, unequivocal” support for a proposal put forward by Macron and Merz on trade policy, with a new instrument to “allow for rapid response” to any imbalances (as covered on the blog on Wednesday).

On the EU budget, he says there are “significant differences” in how countries look at this issue, as “a smaller group” calls for the budget to be reduced, and “a larger group” want it to be expanded further.
“We are all facing the need for substantial fiscal consolidation at home; it is simply not tenable for the European budget to increase by around 50% during the same period,” Merz says.

He says there will be likely an extra council in November with a “multi-day session” in December to discuss this further. He hopes for a deal before the end of the year, but is not sure if that’s going to happen.
Merz also welcomes a new German-French deal on the future policy on automotive industry, concerning certain technologies and climate targets.
“To put it simply: the phaseout of internal combustion engines is now off the table. We are receiving a great deal of support for this,” he says.
The focus is on “technology neutrality,” he says, adding that Italy is “largely in agreement” with the proposals, too.

“This now needs to be integrated into the formal legislative process, but I believe we will be able to reach a final decision at the European level quite quickly. If the European Parliament follows this path, then we will have solved this major problem together,” he says.
EU talks move on from Ukraine to migration and Ceuta

EU leaders have finished their talks on Ukraine and hybrid threats in Europe in the last half hour, according to an EU source. They now move to the topic of migration, where sudden influx of arrivals in Ceuta is likely to be in focus.

articles.title: Israeli settlers attack olive farmers and Washington Post journalist in West Bank
articles.author: William Christou

paras.en: Israeli settlers have attacked Palestinians across the occupied West Bank in a coordinated movement to disrupt the annual olive harvest, burning cars and trees and injuring Palestinians and a Washington Post photographer.

Masked settlers wielding clubs and other weapons attacked people attempting to harvest their olives in West Bank towns on Friday. Palestinian authorities said they recorded attacks in eight villages, and injuries among at least 20 people.

It was the latest series of attacks in a deadly campaign of Israeli settler violence against Palestinians in recent months, violence which has drawn accusations of “ethnic cleansing”, including from the British government.

In the town of Abu Falah, near Ramallah, at least 80 settlers, some of whom were carrying firearms or clubs, gathered to stop Palestinians from harvesting their olives, using slingshots to hurl rocks at the farmers in view of Israeli military vehicles. When some of the Palestinians then picked up rocks to defend themselves, the Israeli military fired teargas in their direction.

The Israeli Foreign Press Association said in a statement: “This is the latest in a long line of violent attacks by Israeli settlers against journalists and other civilians in the occupied West Bank. Yet our repeated calls for action to confront this lawlessness have been ignored by Israeli authorities.”

Among those injured was the Washington Post photographer Heidi Levine, who was beaten by settlers in an attack that lasted more than 10 minutes, according to witnesses. Settlers stole her passport, phone, wallet and equipment.

“I was attacked, pushed to the ground. Luckily, I had my flak jacket and helmet, otherwise I probably wouldn’t even be here, because they just kept kicking and kicking me,” Levine said from a hospital bed in Ramallah. She said the attack ended when her Palestinian colleagues intervened to save her.
In a statement, the Washington Post said Levine had been wearing visible markings clearly identifying her as a journalist.

The office of Israel’s prime minister, Benjamin Netanyahu, said that the facts surrounding the attack on Levine were “unclear”, suggesting the attack was the fault of “200 Arabs and far-left activists” who confronted Israeli youths. The office added that it condemned “violence against anyone”.

There has been a surge of settler violence against Palestinians over the past month. Settlers have carried out at least 170 attacks since 27 September, around the start of the annual olive harvest, according to Yesh Din, an Israeli rights group.
Every year, settlers attack Palestinians trying to harvest their olives, but there has been a rise in violence this year as Israel’s elections approach at the end of October.
At least four Palestinians had been killed and more than 100 others injured over the past month, Palestinian authorities said. Thousands of trees have been damaged.

Israel imposed new rules on the olive harvest this year, barring Palestinians from harvesting their trees located in Area C, an area under the Israeli military’s control, which comprises most of the West Bank’s agricultural land.

The new orders prohibit Palestinians from entering about 8,800 hectares (21,800 acres) of agricultural land – a 30% increase from the year prior – without the approval of the Israeli military. By contrast, the military gave Israeli citizens access to more land this year.

The rights group Peace Now says the military decreased the amount of land Israeli citizens were prohibited from entering from about 1,070 hectares in 2025 to 680 hectares in 2026, for the purpose of preventing settler violence.

The olive harvest is an economic lifeline for Palestinians and has grown in importance since Israel revoked work permits for many Palestinians in the West Bank after the Hamas-led attack on 7 October 2023.
Photos and videos showed large swathes of agricultural land with uprooted olive trees in Kufur Malek, outside Ramallah, where Israeli bulldozers razed trees.

Settlers rarely face accountability for their violence, even when well-documented. Rights groups say settlers enjoy the protection of the Israeli military, which intervenes only if Palestinians try to defend themselves.
Netanyahu, has on occasion condemned the violence, which he says is due to just about 100 settlers, but he has taken few steps to stop it.

Settlements have rapidly expanded across the West Bank under his rightwing government, leading to international condemnation. The UN and most countries judge settlements to be in violation of international law.
Friday’s attack in Abu Falah followed a similar attack hours earlier near the West Bank village of Turmus Ayya, where settlers burned three cars after attacking Palestinians harvesting olives.
Videos shared by the Israeli rights group B’tselem showed hundreds of bags of olives “violently” stolen by Israeli settlers from Palestinians and taken to Israeli olive presses.
Sarit Michaeli, an independent activist, said settlers were stealing Palestinians’ olive crop on a scale “never seen before in my 22-year history of working on this issue”.
A spokesperson for the US embassy in Jerusalem said it was aware of reports of the attack and declined to comment further due to privacy laws.

articles.title: Patients in chains rescued from suspected illegal rehab centre in South Africa

paras.en: A pastor and his wife have been arrested in South Africa after 200 people, some in chains, were found held at a suspected illegal rehabilitation centre in the north-eastern part of the country.
paras.zh: 一名牧师和他的妻子在南非被捕，此前在该国东北部的一个涉嫌非法的康复中心发现了200人，其中一些人被锁在链子里。

paras.en: The facility, operated from a church in Mpumalanga province, was discovered during an operation by officials in the area on Thursday.
paras.zh: 该设施位于姆普马兰加省的一座教堂内，于周四在该地区的一次行动中被发现。

paras.en: Authorities said they uncovered "gross inhumane conditions" when they raided the facility, with some patients found with "sores all over their bodies" and "others chained to each other".
paras.zh: 当局表示，他们在突袭该设施时发现了“严重的不人道条件” ，发现一些患者“全身都有疮” ， “其他人被锁在一起”。

paras.en: Police have since charged the couple, who were running the facility, with kidnapping but could add more charges. They have not yet commented.
paras.zh: 此后，警方指控这对经营该设施的夫妇犯有绑架罪，但可能会增加更多指控。他们尚未发表评论。

paras.en: Illegal rehabilitation centres have mushroomed in South Africa in recent years as drug use spirals in the country.
paras.zh: 近年来，随着南非毒品使用的螺旋上升，非法康复中心在南非如雨后春笋般涌现。

paras.en: Last year, the department of social development said it had uncovered over 100 unlawful facilities operating across the country, mostly in Gauteng province, home to the country's largest city, Johannesburg.
paras.zh: 去年，社会发展部表示，它在全国各地发现了100多个非法设施，其中大部分位于豪登省，该省是该国最大的城市约翰内斯堡的所在地。

paras.en: A girl of 16 and a boy of 11 were found being kept in the same room as adults in the Mpumalanga centre.
paras.zh: 一名16岁的女孩和一名11岁的男孩被发现与姆普马兰加中心的成年人关在同一个房间里。

paras.en: The couple running it told officials they were housing 60 people, but upon inspection, more than three times that number were found, including more than 30 women.
paras.zh: 这对夫妇告诉官员，他们有60人，但经过检查，发现了这个数字的三倍多，其中包括30多名女性。

paras.en: The group, mostly believed to be drug addicts, were found in crowded rooms and without access to functioning bathrooms or running water.
paras.zh: 这群人大多被认为是吸毒成瘾者，他们被发现在拥挤的房间里，无法使用功能齐全的浴室或自来水。

paras.en: "Some [of them had] been at the alleged illegal centre for a while," the department said.
paras.zh: “他们中的一些人已经在所谓的非法中心待了一段时间，”该部门说。

paras.en: Gift Skhosana, one of those held at the facility, told local broadcaster Newzroom Afrika it was "common practice" for patients to be chained.
paras.zh: 在该设施关押的Gift Skhosana告诉当地广播公司Newzroom Afrika ，患者被锁链“常见做法”。

paras.en: "They chain us as punishment [and] when you gain entry," he said.
paras.zh: “当你进入时，他们会把我们锁起来作为惩罚，”他说。

paras.en: Despite this, Skhosana, who was a drug user, said the facility helped him get clean and overcome his addiction.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，吸毒者Skhosana表示，该设施帮助他清理并克服了毒瘾。

paras.en: Another person, who was not named, said his experience with the facility left him needing help mentally.
paras.zh: 另一名未透露姓名的人说，他在该设施的经历使他在精神上需要帮助。

paras.en: The couple charged a monthly fee of 3,000 rand ($182; Â£137) to house the patients, of which almost a half would go to the church.
paras.zh: 这对夫妇每月收取3000兰特（ 182美元； 137英镑）的住宿费，其中近一半将去教堂。

paras.en: Fourteen of those found at the centre have since been taken to hospital for further medical treatment, police said.
paras.zh: 警方称，在该中心发现的14人已被送往医院接受进一步治疗。

paras.en: Officials said 132 have been reunited with their families.
paras.zh: 官员说，已有132人与家人团聚。

paras.en: The couple is expected to appear in a local court on Monday.

articles.title: Zelensky says Ukraine has right to defend itself after Trump calls latest strikes a 'disgrace'

paras.en: President Volodymyr Zelensky has said he is "only standing up for Ukraine's interests" after scathing criticism from Donald Trump, who said Kyiv's new wave of strikes on Russian oil refineries was a "disgrace".
paras.zh: 总统沃洛德米尔·泽伦斯基（ Volodymyr Zelensky ）表示，在唐纳德·特朗普（ Donald Trump ）严厉批评基辅对俄罗斯炼油厂的新一波罢工是“耻辱”之后，他“只会维护乌克兰的利益”。

paras.en: The US president, who recently made a controversial deal with Moscow to import diesel, also said Zelensky was "more difficult to deal with than [Russian President Vladimir] Putin".
paras.zh: 这位美国总统最近与莫斯科达成了一项有争议的进口柴油协议，他还表示，泽伦斯基“比[俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔]普京更难处理”。

paras.en: Zelensky, who has been angered by the diesel deal, said he could not accept it, because a gas agreement could come next. "If I don't stand up to this... who else will?" he said at an EU summit in Brussels.
paras.zh: Zelensky对柴油协议感到愤怒，他说他不能接受，因为接下来可能会达成天然气协议。他在布鲁塞尔举行的欧盟峰会上说： “如果我不挺身而出……还有谁会这么做？”

paras.en: Tensions between Washington and Kyiv have escalated over the diesel deal and curbs on Ukraine's battlefield satellite network.
paras.zh: 华盛顿和基辅之间的紧张关系因柴油协议和对乌克兰战场卫星网络的限制而升级。

paras.en: Zelensky's trip to Brussels, following a visit to London, has come at the end of a bruising week. As he arrived at the summit on Friday, where EU leaders rallied around him in support, Zelensky said it was good to be back among allies. "Leaders, real leaders," he said, in a possible slight to the US president.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基在访问伦敦后前往布鲁塞尔，是在一个伤痕累累的一周结束时。当他于周五抵达峰会时，欧盟领导人聚集在他周围表示支持，泽伦斯基说，回到盟友中是件好事。“领导人，真正的领导人，”他说，对美国总统来说可能是轻微的。

paras.en: At the summit, funding for Ukraine and helping it get through another freezing winter - its fifth since Russia's full-scale invasion in 2022 - topped the agenda.
paras.zh: 在峰会上，为乌克兰提供资金并帮助其度过又一个寒冷的冬天--这是自2022年俄罗斯全面入侵以来的第五个冬天。

paras.en: The war will cost â¬155bn (Â£131bn; $174bn) next year, Zelensky told the European Council, with at least â¬70bn needed to come from the EU for defence and weapons.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基告诉欧洲理事会，这场战争明年将耗资1550亿欧元（ 1310亿英镑； 1740亿美元） ，至少需要来自欧盟的700亿欧元用于国防和武器。

paras.en: Zelensky said that while Ukraine could produce up to three times more drones, it "simply [doesn't] have enough money for that".
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基说，虽然乌克兰可以生产多达三倍的无人机，但它“根本没有足够的资金”。

paras.en: A fundamental problem for Kyiv - which cannot be easily fixed - is the chronic lack of US-made Patriot missiles to defend its towns and cities.
paras.zh: 基辅的一个根本问题--这个问题不容易解决--是长期缺乏美国制造的爱国者导弹来保卫其城镇。

paras.en: Zelensky said he believed Europe did possess all the interceptors his country would need this winter but described them as being scooped up in a piecemeal fashion.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基说，他认为欧洲确实拥有他的国家今年冬天需要的所有拦截器，但他形容这些拦截器是以零敲碎打的方式被攫取的。

paras.en: Zelensky also addressed Ukraine's frayed relationship with the US, saying there are "many people with good hearts in America" who want "to be allies, not to divide or humiliate Europe".
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基还谈到了乌克兰与美国的紧张关系，称“美国有许多心地善良的人”希望“成为盟友，而不是分裂或羞辱欧洲”。

paras.en: Trump has heavily criticised Zelensky for resuming strikes on Russian oil refineries earlier this week, because it could impact Moscow's ability to complete its part of the diesel deal, which will see 300,000 tonnes of diesel sent to "the American and global marketplace".
paras.zh: 特朗普严厉批评泽伦斯基本周早些时候恢复对俄罗斯炼油厂的罢工，因为这可能会影响莫斯科完成柴油协议部分的能力，该协议将向“美国和全球市场”运送30万吨柴油。

paras.en: As both Russia and Ukraine continued attacking each other's energy infrastructure, Trump suddenly announced a ceasefire on the facilities last week.
paras.zh: 随着俄罗斯和乌克兰继续攻击对方的能源基础设施，特朗普上周突然宣布停火。

paras.en: Kyiv said it would stop the strikes if Russia did the same, but Moscow said it had never agreed to the deal and continued its attacks. After three days, Kyiv resumed its strikes.
paras.zh: 基辅表示，如果俄罗斯也这样做，它将停止罢工，但莫斯科表示，它从未同意这项协议，并继续发动袭击。三天后，基辅恢复了罢工。

paras.en: Trump's comments about Zelensky, during an interview with US outlet Newsmax on Thursday evening, reflect the deteriorating relationship between the US and Ukraine.
paras.zh: 特朗普在周四晚间接受美国媒体Newsmax采访时对泽伦斯基的评论反映了美国和乌克兰之间关系的恶化。

paras.en: The US president said he was "not a big fan of Zelensky" and that he was "not a good guy for us to deal with".
paras.zh: 这位美国总统表示，他“不是泽伦斯基的忠实粉丝” ，他“对我们来说不是一个好人”。

paras.en: "He doesn't want to settle," Trump said. "He says he wants to settle, but he doesn't."
paras.zh: “他不想和解，”特朗普说。“他说他想和解，但他没有。”

paras.en: "As you know, Putin hates Zelensky, and Zelensky hates Putin," he added. "And when you have that kind of hatred, it's very hard to get something settled."
paras.zh: “如你所知，普京讨厌泽伦斯基，泽伦斯基讨厌普京，”他补充说。“当你有那种仇恨时，很难解决问题。”

paras.en: When asked about Ukraine's renewed strikes on Russian oil refineries, Trump said of Zelensky: "All he's doing is making the world oil price higher... There are a lot of targets that you can hit."
paras.zh: 当被问及乌克兰重新对俄罗斯炼油厂进行罢工时，特朗普谈到泽伦斯基： “他所做的只是让世界油价上涨……你可以达到很多目标。”

paras.en: Trump is frustrated at Ukraine's continued targeting of Russia's oil facilities, because it affects Moscow's ability to export its diesel to America, as per the deal the US has made with Russia, in an effort to bring down fuel prices.
paras.zh: 特朗普对乌克兰继续瞄准俄罗斯的石油设施感到沮丧，因为它影响了莫斯科根据美国与俄罗斯达成的协议向美国出口柴油的能力，以降低燃料价格。

paras.en: Since the war with Iran started in February, US fuel and especially diesel prices have skyrocketed, souring Trump's standing with the American public - something he wants to fix before next month's mid-term elections.
paras.zh: 自2月与伊朗的战争开始以来，美国燃料价格，特别是柴油价格飙升，使特朗普在美国公众中的地位恶化--他希望在下个月的中期选举之前解决这个问题。

paras.en: At a news conference after the EU summit, Zelensky was asked if he felt that Trump was using him as a scapegoat for his own political problems. After a pause, the president broke into a grin, prompting laughter from the journalists in the room.
paras.zh: 在欧盟峰会后的新闻发布会上，泽伦斯基被问及他是否觉得特朗普正在利用他作为自己政治问题的替罪羊。停顿了一下，总统咧嘴一笑，引起了房间里记者的笑声。

paras.en: The diesel deal infuriated Zelensky, who called it a gift to Putin and on Friday said it would "put more money straight into Putin's pocket to fund this war".
paras.zh: 柴油协议激怒了泽伦斯基，他称之为给普京的礼物，并于周五表示将“直接向普京的口袋里投入更多资金来资助这场战争”。

paras.en: His anger was further heightened earlier this week, when restrictions were placed on the US-owned Starlink internet network, which is critical for Kyiv's military abilities to defend itself.
paras.zh: 本周早些时候，当美国拥有的Starlink互联网网络受到限制时，他的愤怒进一步加剧，这对基辅的军事自卫能力至关重要。

paras.en: During the slowdown on Tuesday night, there were several deadly Russian strikes on Ukraine, with residents and the government saying there was no prior warning.
paras.zh: 在周二晚上的经济放缓期间，俄罗斯对乌克兰进行了几次致命的袭击，居民和政府表示没有事先警告。

paras.en: On Friday, Zelensky called the slowdown a "very dangerous and unpleasant surprise", adding that Starlink speeds were still not fully restored.
paras.zh: 周五，泽伦斯基称减速是一个“非常危险和不愉快的惊喜” ，并补充说Starlink的速度仍然没有完全恢复。

paras.en: The Trump administration had previously warned that it could withhold intelligence-sharing - crucial for Ukraine's defences - if Kyiv does not stop hitting Russia's oil refineries.
paras.zh: 特朗普政府此前曾警告说，如果基辅不停止打击俄罗斯的炼油厂，它可能会拒绝情报共享--这对乌克兰的防御至关重要。

paras.en: As the diplomatic wrangling continues, so too have deadly attacks on Ukraine.
paras.zh: 随着外交争吵的继续，对乌克兰的致命袭击也在继续。

paras.en: Several people were killed in a Russian drone strike on Kharkiv on Thursday night. local officials say
paras.zh: 当地官员说，周四晚上，俄罗斯无人机袭击哈尔科夫，造成数人死亡。

paras.en: Russian officials say the airspace above Moscow was closed for hours after Ukrainian strikes, with 644 drones intercepted over 26 Russian regions.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯官员表示，莫斯科上空的领空在乌克兰空袭后关闭了数小时，在26个俄罗斯地区拦截了644架无人机。

paras.en: Satellite images show Russia's new drone base
paras.zh: 卫星图像显示俄罗斯新的无人机基地

paras.en: Satellite images have revealed how Russia has almost finished building a drone base in just six weeks, and how Kyiv is continuing to fight back with its own air power.
paras.zh: 卫星图像揭示了俄罗斯如何在短短六周内几乎完成了无人机基地的建设，以及基辅如何继续用自己的空中力量进行反击。

paras.en: Experts have told BBC Verify that the new facility two miles (3.5km) from the Millerovo airbase, near the border in Russia's Rostov region, seems designed to accommodate powerful jet drones, linked to deadly strikes on civilian targets.
paras.zh: 专家告诉BBC Verify ，距离俄罗斯罗斯托夫地区边境附近的米列罗沃空军基地两英里（ 3.5公里）的新设施似乎旨在容纳强大的喷气式无人机，这些无人机与对平民目标的致命袭击有关。

paras.en: The site was an empty field as recently as late August.
paras.zh: 直到8月下旬，该网站还是一个空字段。

paras.en: Justin Crump, from risk intelligence company Sibylline, said the base signalled that Moscow intended to "increase the tempo of its strikes against Ukraine this winter".
paras.zh: 风险情报公司Sibylline的贾斯汀·克伦普（ Justin Crump ）表示，该基地表示，莫斯科打算“加快今年冬天对乌克兰的打击速度”。

paras.en: Meanwhile, imagery from US-based intelligence firm Vantor shows a Ukrainian missile attack has destroyed several Su-34 fighter bombers at the Borisoglebsk airbase in Voronezh region.
paras.zh: 与此同时，美国情报公司Vantor的图像显示，乌克兰导弹袭击摧毁了沃罗涅日地区鲍里索格列布斯克空军基地的几架苏-34战斗轰炸机。

paras.en: A large burn mark, debris and significant damage are visible in the spot where an image taken days earlier showed several Su-34 fighter bombers lined up on the tarmac.
paras.zh: 几天前拍摄的一张照片显示，停机坪上排列着几架苏-34战斗轰炸机，现场可见大量燃烧痕迹、碎片和严重损坏。

articles.title: Inside Ukrainian offensive pushing Russia back on front line where Starlink plays a key role

paras.en: A Russian drone zips across the computer screen, startling the commanders keeping watch over the battlefield via a live stream in their bunker.
paras.zh: 一架俄罗斯无人机在电脑屏幕上拉开拉链，通过掩体中的实时流来监视战场，这让指挥官们感到震惊。

paras.en: Cigarette in one hand, radio in the other, one of them calls in their own drone to bring it down and warns the soldiers below of the threat. The men are dangerously exposed, on the long walk across open ground from their front line positions. They are being replaced after three months forcing the Russians back.
paras.zh: 一只手拿着香烟，另一只手拿着收音机，其中一人呼叫自己的无人机将其击落，并向下面的士兵发出威胁的警告。这些人在从前线阵地穿过开阔地面的长途步行中危险地暴露在外。他们在三个月后被替换，迫使俄罗斯人回来。

paras.en: This is part of Operation Vivaldi, a Ukrainian counter-offensive which they say has liberated 277 sq km (106 square miles) in the eastern Donbas region in recent months.
paras.zh: 这是维瓦尔第行动的一部分，这是乌克兰的一次反攻，他们说最近几个月在顿巴斯东部地区解放了277平方公里（ 106平方英里）。

paras.en: The name reflects the offensive's four stages, or seasons - like the Italian composer's violin concerto. The successful assault blunted an attempted Russian pincer movement that threatened to encircle the key Fortress Belt cities still under Ukrainian control.
paras.zh: 这个名字反映了攻势的四个阶段或季节，就像意大利作曲家的小提琴协奏曲一样。这次成功的袭击削弱了俄罗斯企图包围仍在乌克兰控制下的主要堡垒地带城市的钳击运动。

paras.en: While Russia this month pummels Ukraine from the air, crippling its energy infrastructure and killing scores of civilians across the country, at the front, it is Ukraine that has made recent gains. Kyiv says it has inflicted heavy losses - 8,000 Russian casualties in Vivaldi alone, and close to 50,000 along the front in the month of September â and suffered few casualties in return.
paras.zh: 虽然俄罗斯本月从空中打击乌克兰，破坏了其能源基础设施，并在全国各地杀害了数十名平民，但在前线，乌克兰最近取得了进展。基辅表示，它造成了重大损失-仅在维瓦尔第就有8,000名俄罗斯人伤亡， 9月份在前线接近50,000人-并且伤亡人数很少。

paras.en: The Institute for the Study of War reported that pro-Russian military bloggers had acknowledged the Ukrainian advances, and expressed fears this could lead to more losses for Russia in the future. No Russian official has publicly acknowledged the Ukrainian gains. Russian ministry of defence briefings say only that they were "repelling attacks" in the Lyman region, or "improving the tactical position at the front".
paras.zh: 战争研究所报告说，亲俄军事博客作者承认乌克兰的进步，并表示担心这可能导致俄罗斯未来遭受更多损失。没有俄罗斯官员公开承认乌克兰的收益。俄罗斯国防部通报称，他们只是“击退了莱曼地区的袭击” ，或“改善了前线的战术阵地”。

paras.en: Despite Ukraine's forward moves, Russian drones are still ever-present. Phoenix, Commandant of the Revenge Brigade's Silver Trinity unit, tells me his men face 10 on an average day.
paras.zh: 尽管乌克兰向前迈进，但俄罗斯无人机仍然存在。复仇旅银色三位一体部队的指挥官菲尼克斯告诉我，他的手下平均每天要面对10个人。

paras.en: He is fixed on the live stream as a Ukrainian snare swoops in, hovers for a few seconds and drops a net on to the drone, dragging it from the sky. This Russian drone was for reconnaissance, but if it had locked on to the soldiers, another drone carrying explosives would have followed.
paras.zh: 他被固定在直播中，乌克兰陷阱俯冲而来，盘旋了几秒钟，然后把网撒在无人机上，从天而降。这架俄罗斯无人机用于侦察，但如果它锁定在士兵身上，另一架携带爆炸物的无人机就会跟随。

paras.en: This moment of peril illustrates the layers making up the modern battlefield. The command bunker receives live pictures from a hovering camera, while below a Ukrainian attack drone attacks another enemy spotter which would have called in more flying firepower.
paras.zh: 这一危险时刻说明了构成现代战场的各个层次。指挥掩体从悬停的摄像头接收实时图片，而在乌克兰攻击无人机下方攻击另一名敌方探测器，该探测器将需要更多的飞行火力。

paras.en: Integrated in all of this is Starshield, the military version of Elon Musk's Starlink satellite communications network, providing broadband connectivity across the battlefield.
paras.zh: 其中集成了Starshield ，这是埃隆·马斯克（ Elon Musk ）的Starlink卫星通信网络的军用版本，可在战场上提供宽带连接。

paras.en: Ukraine said this week, as Operation Vivaldi concluded, that the system had restrictions imposed without warning, limiting their capability.
paras.zh: 正如维瓦尔第行动得出的结论，乌克兰本周表示，该系统在没有警告的情况下受到限制，限制了它们的能力。

paras.en: Musk and media reports suggest the order may have come from the White House. While Ukraine is not wholly reliant on Starshield, it is a key tool in their arsenal, vital for interceptor and mid-range strike drones. And knowing this tool can be restricted without any warning or consultation has sparked major concern in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 马斯克和媒体报道称，该命令可能来自白宫。虽然乌克兰并不完全依赖Starshield ，但它是其武器库中的关键工具，对于拦截和中程攻击无人机至关重要。知道这个工具可以在没有任何警告或咨询的情况下受到限制，这在乌克兰引起了严重关切。

paras.en: Beneath the battle for aerial superiority, unmanned ground vehicles scurry back and forth delivering supplies, evacuating the wounded or, increasingly, leading the charge against the enemy.
paras.zh: 在争夺空中优势的战斗中，无人驾驶地面车辆来回运送物资，疏散伤员，或者越来越多地领导对敌人的冲锋。

paras.en: Everything here relies on digital connectivity - to see, to move, to fly, to communicate, to fire. But at the bottom of this stack, it is still human beings in trenches who are holding the ground.
paras.zh: 这里的一切都依赖于数字连接--去看、去移动、去飞行、去交流、去开火。但在这个堆栈的底部，仍然是人类在战壕里支撑着地面。

paras.en: The weary soldiers have made it safely to the command post. After 95 days pushing forward on the front line there is an emotional reunion.
paras.zh: 疲惫不堪的士兵已安全抵达指挥所。在前线推进95天后，情感重聚。

paras.en: An infantryman with the call-sign Dealer tells me he feels strong, but it is good to be finally heading home: "It's an impressive operation. Over three months, we moved positions four times."
paras.zh: 一个带着招牌经销商的步兵告诉我，他感觉很强壮，但最终回家是件好事： “这是一次令人印象深刻的行动。三个多月来，我们换了四次岗位。”

paras.en: He tells me the most frightening threat was Russian drones, piloted remotely and determined to hunt down their target.
paras.zh: 他告诉我，最可怕的威胁是遥控驾驶的俄罗斯无人机，并决心追捕他们的目标。

paras.en: Commandant Phoenix said the preparation for the offensive was "enormous".
paras.zh: 菲尼克斯指挥官说，进攻的准备工作是“巨大的”。

paras.en: "The men trained for months. We had to completely restructure our approach because previously we had been defending, and now we had to go on the offensive."
paras.zh: “这些人训练了几个月。我们不得不彻底重组我们的方法，因为以前我们一直在防守，现在我们不得不继续进攻。”

paras.en: Robots and drones led the assault on Russian positions and, for the first time, remote-controlled explosive vehicles were dropped behind Russian lines - 250 Russians surrendered. According to Ukrainian commanders, their year-long campaign has freed 16 settlements from Russian occupation.
paras.zh: 机器人和无人机领导了对俄罗斯阵地的攻击，遥控爆炸车辆首次落在俄罗斯防线后面- 250名俄罗斯人投降。根据乌克兰指挥官的说法，他们长达一年的运动使16个定居点摆脱了俄罗斯的占领。

paras.en: In Karpivka, a village occupied since April, the Ukrainians found one local resident remaining - 61 year old Volodymyr Zamota, the last man standing when his neighbours fled the Russian advance in 2025. He says he survived for eight months in total isolation.
paras.zh: 在卡尔皮夫卡（ Karpivka ） ，一个自4月以来一直被占领的村庄，乌克兰人发现仍有一名当地居民--61岁的沃洛迪米尔·扎莫塔（ Volodymyr Zamota ） ，他是2025年邻居逃离俄罗斯军队时站立的最后一名男子。他说，他在完全隔离的情况下存活了8个月。

paras.en: "As they say, hope dies last," he told me. "I'm the only person left in the whole village, and the village has been almost completely destroyed."
paras.zh: “正如他们所说，希望终将消逝，”他告诉我。“全村只剩下我一个人，村庄几乎被彻底摧毁了。”

paras.en: "I thought I would live to old age without experiencing anything like this, but then it happened. It's a terrible tragedy".
paras.zh: “我以为我会活到老年，没有经历过这样的事情，但后来它发生了。这是一场可怕的悲剧”。

paras.en: That devastation defines the region Ukraine has just recaptured. It's still too risky for residents to return, if they even have a home intact. But Ukraine's soldiers are celebrating this regained ground, the halted Russian advance and the future potential this operation may present.
paras.zh: 这场灾难定义了乌克兰刚刚夺回的地区。即使房屋完好无损，居民返回的风险仍然太大。但乌克兰士兵正在庆祝这一收复失地、俄罗斯停止前进以及这次行动可能带来的未来潜力。

paras.en: "The real value of this is securing advantageous positions, favourable lines, and a bridgehead that grants us a superior position," Andriy Hitt, Revenge Bridge chief of staff, explained.
paras.zh: 复仇桥参谋长安德烈·希特（ Andriy Hitt ）解释说： “这样做的真正价值在于确保有利的位置，有利的路线，以及给予我们优越地位的桥头堡。”

paras.en: "This allows us to create the necessary conditions for subsequent successful operations, seize the initiative in battle, and plan future successful manoeuvresâ¦ each of these actions is a building block towards victory."
paras.zh: “这使我们能够为随后的成功行动创造必要的条件，在战斗中抓住主动权，并计划未来的成功演习......这些行动中的每一个都是通往胜利的基石。”

paras.en: All this could be threatened by the limitations on US technology, and American intelligence. Relations between Kyiv and Washington are at an all-time low.
paras.zh: 所有这些都可能受到美国技术和美国情报局限性的威胁。基辅和华盛顿之间的关系处于历史最低点。

paras.en: This week President Zelensky said he felt "betrayed" by Donald Trump, while the US leader declared he was "not a fan" of his Ukrainian counterpart, saying he was harder to deal with than Vladimir Putin.
paras.zh: 本周，泽伦斯基总统表示，他感到被唐纳德·特朗普“背叛” ，而美国领导人宣称他“不是乌克兰总统的粉丝” ，称他比弗拉基米尔·普京更难对付。

paras.en: Trump says Ukraine's strikes on Russian oil refineries have hiked oil prices. Ukraine says the US and Israeli war against Iran is the cause.
paras.zh: 特朗普表示，乌克兰对俄罗斯炼油厂的罢工导致油价上涨。乌克兰表示，美国和以色列对伊朗的战争是原因。

paras.en: But despite the diplomatic divisions, among the soldiers we met, morale is high. Dealer says Operation Vivaldi has renewed his belief Ukraine can win the war.
paras.zh: 但是，尽管存在外交分歧，在我们遇到的士兵中，士气很高。经销商表示，维瓦尔第行动重申了他的信念，即乌克兰可以赢得这场战争。

paras.en: The unit is ensuring Volodymyr, Grandpa as they call him, has enough to eat - drones drop off food parcels on their way to feed soldiers at the front.
paras.zh: 该部队正在确保他们称之为爷爷的Volodymyr有足够的食物-无人机在前线为士兵提供食物包裹。

paras.en: I asked Volodymyr if he believed Ukraine could win. "Yes, of course I do. I would just like to know when it will happen, when all of this will finally end."
paras.zh: 我问Volodymyr是否相信乌克兰会赢。“是的，我当然知道。我只是想知道它什么时候会发生，什么时候这一切最终会结束。”

paras.en: Additional reporting by Kostas Kallergis and Anastasiia Levchenko
paras.zh: Kostas Kallergis和Anastasiia Levchenko的补充报道

articles.title: Off-Highway Brake & Friction Excellence is All-Italian

paras.en: Off-Highway Brake & Friction Excellence is All-Italian

SK Wellman, a company specializing in the production of brake and frictions components for off-highway, has a lively DNA. A historical reality in Orzinuovi (Bs), where the plant is still located, over the years it has undergone transformations and changes that have contributed to making it what it is today: an evolved company, able to grow in loyalty to the local Italian territory and to innovate its sector with creativity and flexibility worldwide. Today, as part of the CentroMotion Group and its Carlisle Brake & Friction division, SK Wellman is a leader in its segment, recognized and chosen by major brands in earthmoving, agricultural and construction machinery. Engineer Alessandro Gamba, Global Director of Friction Engineering, tells us about the ongoing growth.

paras.en: "S.K. Wellman S.R.L. has 340 employees and a turnover of 127 million by 2023," Gamba begins. articles.title: GM, Ford active safety engineers to speak during SCRS OEM Summit at SEMA Show
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: At the SEMA Show next month, active safety engineers from General Motors and Ford will provide a look behind the engineering decisions that influence vehicle safety before, during, and after a collision.

They’ll speak during the second session of the Society of Collision Repair Specialists’ (SCRS) 2026 OEM Collision Repair Technology Summit, titled “Engineering the Safety Benefit: From Requirements to Real-World Performance,” Thursday, Nov. 5, from 2–3 p.m.

It will follow an earlier session featuring National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) Deputy Administrator Lee White from 12:30–1:30 p.m. White will examine vehicle safety priorities and the agency’s role in advancing safety on U.S. roadways.
To register for all three OEM Summit sessions, visit here.
An SCRS RDE Full Series Pass provides access to Tuesday and Wednesday RDE sessions, the IDEAS Collide Showcase, Thursday’s OEM Collision Repair Technology Summit, and the SCRS Afterparty.

“This second session will move from those broader safety objectives into the vehicle itself, examining how automakers translate requirements and safety goals into technologies designed to produce measurable real-world benefits,” an SCRS press release states. “The afternoon will then progress to the collision repair environment, exploring how those engineered capabilities are preserved and restored after a vehicle has been damaged.”

The second session will bring together engineers who are responsible for developing, evaluating, and measuring advanced vehicle safety systems. Attendees will learn about the engineering decisions that influence vehicle safety.

Panelists include Michael Carpenter, General Motors Active Safety and Global Vehicle Performance owner; Jameson Collins, General Motors Active Safety and staff product manager; and Jeremy Nelson, Ford Motor Co. ADAS application systems engineer.

Carpenter works within GM Global Product Safety, Systems, and Certification on ADAS technology and performance strategies, new technology development, implementation of regulatory and consumer metric requirements, ADAS field effectiveness and safety benefits, and industry collaboration on standards and test-method development.

Collins leads product strategy, roadmap development, and delivery for GM’s Active Safety features, translating customer needs, competitive insights, and regulatory requirements into technologies intended to improve safety and the driving experience.

Nelson focuses on the development, release, integration, and servicing of advanced driver assistance system domain controllers. He supports vehicle production and development milestones while troubleshooting ADAS components and working across engineering, quality, and product development teams to ensure systems perform safely and as intended.

The discussion will be moderated by Jake Rodenroth, automotive industry executive, and will move beyond what ADAS features do to examine why they exist, how their intended performance is established, and how their effectiveness is evaluated. This will include what it means when a safety system is absent, disabled, damaged, or operating outside its intended parameters.

The release states: “That progression leads directly to a fundamental question for collision repair professionals: If a vehicle entered a collision with a measurable safety capability, how can the repairer know that capability has been restored?”

The panel will also explore ADAS feature development, real-world effectiveness, crash avoidance and mitigation, implications of inoperable systems, verification of safety performance, and the potential for system degradation.
The 2026 OEM Collision Repair Technology Summit is part of SCRS’ Repairer Driven Education (RDE) program at the SEMA Show.

“The Summit brings collision repair professionals together with automakers, engineers, regulators, and other subject-matter experts to examine emerging technologies and their implications for safe and complete vehicle repair,” the release states.

During the first session, White will present on the agency’s current vehicle and roadway safety priorities, emerging transportation technologies, data-driven research, and the federal government’s work with the industry to reduce fatalities and serious injuries, an SCRS release states.

Following White’s presentation, he will sit down with Aaron Schulenburg, SCRS executive director, for a one-on-one conversation exploring the intersection between federal safety objectives, automotive innovation, and the collision repair industry’s role in preserving vehicle safety throughout its service life.
NHTSA sits at the center of many discussions that impact the collision repair industry.

During a July Collision Industry Conference meeting, Schulenburg discussed NHTSA’s investigation into counterfeit airbags with Teena Bohi, an Automotive Anti-Counterfeiting Council (A2C2) Board member.

In April, NHTSA announced a ban on one type of counterfeit airbag part. Before the ban, it also issued an “urgent” industry alert specifically asking the auto repair industry to look for dangerous airbag inflators.
Repair procedures are impacted by NHTSA-mandated vehicle safety technology. This includes mandated backup cameras in all new vehicles under 10,000 pounds as of May 2018.
NHTSA also has a final rule that mandates automatic emergency braking (AEB) in pedestrian vehicles by September 2029.
However, NHTSA also announced it paused the rule to give the Trump administration time to review it following pushback and a lawsuit filed by the Alliance of Automotive Innovation (Auto Innovators).
Additional information about SCRS and RDE can be found at www.scrs.come/rde
For more information about SCRS or to join as a member, visit www.scrs.com, call 877-841-0660, or email [email protected]

articles.title: Class action lawsuit filed against CCC alleging consumer personal information misuse
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: A class action lawsuit filed Oct. 8 in California against CCC Intelligent Solutions and CCC Intelligent Solutions Holdings alleges that CCC stores personally identifiable information (PII) from collision repair estimates created in CCC ONE to inform its artificial intelligence products and analytics.

The PII in question includes customer names, home addresses, phone numbers, insurance claim numbers, vehicle identification numbers, license plate numbers, and vehicle mileage. CCC also stores photos of damaged vehicles, according to the suit.
Plaintiffs LaTrenda Zekenya Burries, Gloribel Lissbeth Garcia, and Katleen Saturné were all involved in vehicle collisions and sought repairs at California collision repair facilities.
The suit alleges intrusion upon seclusion, invasion of privacy under the California Constitution, unjust enrichment, and violation of California’s unfair competition law.

The Law Offices of Maro Burunsuzyan, on behalf of the plaintiffs, says the alleged harm is the loss of privacy and control over personal information, including the ability to decide whether it could be repurposed and commercially exploited, as well as being deprived of resulting economic value.

CCC allegedly combines stored PII with data across its network to build AI products and analytics that it licenses to other customers without notice, consent, or compensation to the consumers who own the information, according to the complaint.
When Repairer Driven News asked CCC for comment on the suit, CCC replied that it “doesn’t comment on pending litigation.”

“Its contract with insurers provides that ‘CCC may use data to train AI Services,'” the complaint states. “Its contract with repair facilities reserves to CCC the use of the facility’s data for CCC’s own ‘product improvement, and research and development,’ a use that ‘may continue after the expiration or termination of this agreement.’ CCC tells consumers none of this. No page of the estimate describes CCC’s retention, aggregation, or commercial use of the personal information, or gives the consumer any way to opt out of it, see it, or delete it.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: The suit adds that a repair facility’s contract with CCC doesn’t equal consumers’ consent for CCC to collect and use their data.
“CCC’s own contract anticipates as much by requiring the repair facility to indemnify CCC ‘for failure to obtain the requisite authorizations,'” the suit states.

The agreements noted in the suit are CCC’s Repair Facility License Agreement, effective in 2018; form Independent Appraiser Master License Agreement, reflected in a product schedule executed in 2024; the Insurer MSA, CCC’s public Master Services Agreement for insurers, last updated Nov. 7, 2025; and CCC’s companion Data Processing Addendum (DPA), last updated Nov. 4, 2025.

According to the suit, the Repair Facility License Agreement “authorizes CCC to provide the repair ‘content’ to insurers whose direct repair programs the shop participates in, or with whom the shop configures CCC ONE UpdatePlus to share information, and separately authorizes CCC to provide the Content to CCC’s vendor, Flash of Genius, Inc. (d/b/a UpdatePromise) (“Flash”), granting the identified insurers, CCC, and that vendor ‘perpetual, royalty-free licenses to use the content.'”
The agreement also “forbids the repair facility itself to ‘compile estimate data for the purpose of creating a database,’ a use that CCC reserves to itself…”

The Appraiser License Agreement also forbids the appraiser to “‘compile estimate data for the purpose of creating a database'” and “‘aggregate or co-mingle data in the programs and/or services or provide reports or analysis based on data in the programs and/or services to anyone.'”

It notes as well that a section of the Insurer MSA, titled “License by Customer to CCC,” “contemplates the development or testing of artificial intelligence tools or models on Customer Data that has not been de-identified, subject only to the customer’s prior written approval, which the provision states CCC may accept by e-mail from a vice-president-level or higher employee of the customer.”
The plaintiffs contend that consumers aren’t parties or signatories to the aforementioned agreements despite CCC’s collection, movement, and licensing of their personal information.

“The Repair Facility License Agreement runs between CCC and a collision repair facility, the Appraiser License Agreement runs between CCC and an independent appraiser, and the Insurer MSA and DPA run between CCC and an insurer,” the suit states.

“The only authorization CCC obtains to take and use consumers’ personal information under these agreements is the business’s own promise: under the Repair Facility License Agreement, customer ‘represents and warrants that it has full right and authority to provide the authorization and licenses contained herein,’ and indemnifies CCC ‘for failure to obtain the requisite authorizations;’ and under the Appraiser License Agreement, customer ‘represents and warrants that it has the right to provide the data to CCC.'”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: The suit also states that CCC has patented training AI models on identifiable consumer data and harvesting vehicle event data recorder information, including U.S. Patent No. 10,922,726; U.S. Patent No. 11,727,551; and U.S. Patent No. 9,500,545.

“Taken together, these patents describe CCC’s designs for systems that ingest, store, retrain on, and reuse identifiable consumer and vehicle data of the kinds that populate CCC ONE, including names, home addresses, VINs, license plates, policy and claim identifiers, and event-data-recorder data,” the suit states. “On information and belief, CCC has implemented these designs in the CCC ONE platform and in the artificial-intelligence products and analytics it licenses to insurers and other customers.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: The proposed nationwide class includes more than 15 million U.S. vehicle owners or customers named on repair estimates that a U.S. collision repair facility prepared on CCC ONE in the four years before the complaint was filed. It also proposes a nationwide intrusion subclass and a California subclass.

Relief sought includes nominal and punitive damages, restitution and disgorgement of the value CCC obtained from consumers’ information, barring CCC from using consumer information for AI training or other purposes beyond the estimate without consent, and requiring CCC to delete consumer PII.

An injunction on behalf of the California subclass would require CCC to inform California consumers before or when their personal information is entered into CCC ONE at a collision repair facility of its identity, the categories of PII it collects, and the purposes of use for the PII. It would also require CCC to obtain consumer consent before using PII for any purpose beyond preparing or transmitting vehicle estimates or valuations.
CCC hadn’t filed a response to the suit in court as of Monday afternoon.

“Artificial intelligence is reshaping the economy, and the question of what these systems are built on has never mattered more,” said Maro Burunsuzyan, attorney for the plaintiffs and founder of the Law Offices of Maro Burunsuzyan, in a press release.

“The complaint alleges that, in CCC’s case, part of the answer is the personal information of ordinary people who simply needed a car repaired. Those drivers were never told, never asked, and never paid. This case is about restoring a basic principle: a company that wants to profit from your information should have to ask you first.”

articles.title: Volvo research shows automaker has decreased injury for men and women by 79%
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: A new report from Volvo finds that equal protection for men and women can be achieved through data-driven safety development grounded in real-world crash research, the release states.
The research found that overall injury for drivers has decreased by 79% for Volvo models from 2010 to 2019 compared to models from 1970 to 1979.
Volvo saw an 88% decrease for women, bringing the injury risk to the same level as men, the release states.

“The results also show substantial advances in occupant protection across all seating positions,” the release adds. “Restrained rear-seat occupants in Volvo cars benefit from protection levels comparable to, and in some cases exceeding, those of front-seat occupants.”

Volvo says the data underscores the effectiveness of decades of rear-seat safety innovation in Volvo cars. This happened with the lack of regulatory requirements and standardized testing, the release states.

“For too long, safety in the automotive industry has not worked equally well for everyone,” says Åsa Haglund, Volvo head of Cars Safety Centre, in the release. “At Volvo Cars, we’ve taken a different approach. By studying real-world crashes and designing with the needs of women, men and children of all body types in mind, we’ve worked for decades to provide a high level of protection regardless of who you are or where you sit in the car. Our latest research confirms that equal protection is not just an ambition, but something we have been able to achieve in Volvo cars for many years.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Volvo has collected data since 1970 from more than 50,000 real-world crashes involving more than 80,000 occupants, the release notes. It adds that the insights are translated into safety requirements, testing, vehicle development, verification, and production.
“The result is a continuous cycle of learning that helps drive innovations and improve protection for everyone,” according to the release.
The study also reviewed different crash types. It found that frontal impact injuries were reduced by 79% for all drivers. Side impacts saw a larger reduction in injuries at 89%.

The approach also laid the foundation for pioneering Volvo Cars Safety Standard, according to the release. Through the standard, Volvo sets its own benchmark for real-world safety, going beyond regulation or safety ratings, Volvo says.

“And because real-world crashes don’t involve standardized crash test dummies, Volvo Cars’ research involves considering a diverse range of occupant characteristics, including gender, height, body shape and weight,” the release states. “As a result, the company’s safety innovations are designed with the same diversity in mind.”

Volvo notes it has openly shared its safety research to help raise safety standards across the industry through the Equal Vehicles for All (E.V.A.) initiative launched in 2019. It adds that more than 50 years of safety research is freely accessible in a digital library. Carmakers, researchers and policyholders can use the data to build on Volvo’s insights.

The recent study focuses on a broad range of real-world crash scenarios, including frontal, side, and rear-end impacts; run-off-road collisions; rollovers; side-swipe collisions; large animal impacts; and multi-collision crashes.

It also focuses on belted occupants aged 13 or older and examines injuries with moderate potential to threaten life, such as fractures and concussions, while excluding minor injuries such as bruises and pain.
Earlier this year, Volvo introduced a new seatbelt that adapts to traffic variations and the person wearing it via real-time data.
The Volvo EX60 was the first vehicle equipped with the multi-adaptive seatbelt.

The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) released research in January that found women are at higher risk of injury than men in collisions. The research followed details released by the U.S. Department of Transportation on an advanced female crash test dummy.

articles.title: The Penny Test to Measure Tire Tread is Outdated
articles.author: Christian Hinton

paras.en: The quarter tire test can provide an earlier warning of tire wear than the traditional penny test. The penny test checks for about 2/32˝ of tread, while a quarter checks closer to 4/32˝.
The 2/32˝ measurement represents the minimum replacement point. Checking at 4/32˝ gives drivers more time to plan for tire replacement.

Insert a quarter into the tire tread with Washington’s head facing down. If the top of Washington’s head disappears, the tire has at least 4/32˝ of tread. If the top of his head remains visible, drivers can begin planning for replacement.

In wet-weather testing, tires worn to 4/32˝ took an average of 87 feet longer to stop than new tires. Wet performance can therefore decline before tread reaches the level measured by the penny test. The quarter test provides an earlier indication of tread wear.

articles.title: Alignment Spec: Toyota RAV4 2006-2013
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: The third generation of the Toyota RAV4 shares all of the same infrastructure with the Corolla and many other Toyota vehicles. The front suspension is easy to adjust, while the rear needs a little more attention.

If you get one in your shop, it’s what you do after you adjust the angles that can make or break the alignment. The RAV4 has electric power steering and the stability control is a very common option. These systems need to know the correct steering angle to operate. If it is not reset, it could result in the customer coming back with the VSA or steering malfunction indicator light on.

Always pay attention to the ride height. If the springs are weak, it can change the camber and caster in the front. In the rear, weak springs can change the camber and toe and cause the inner edges of the tires to wear prematurely. Often many of the alignment angles can be corrected with new springs or loaded struts.

The front suspension on the RAV4 uses a MacPherson strut design. Caster is not adjustable from the factory. Camber can be adjusted using additional parts. Toyota uses coded bolts with dots on the heads that indicate a fixed range of camber. But, the aftermarket has a better solution, with cam bolts that can adjust ±1.75 degrees.

The most common wear points for the RAV4 are the lower control arms. The bushings on the arm can degrade and cause changes in the caster, camber and toe. Changing the control arm involves removing the lower crossmember.

The rear suspension is a multilink design. On high-mileage vehicles, inspect the lower knuckle bushing for play and deflection. Another sign of a worn bushing is premature tire wear on the inside edge of the rear tires.

The rear toe links use a sleeve that connects the two portions of the rod. The sleeves are problematic. The sleeves and jam nuts can come loose if you don’t take your time using the correct procedures. Don’t try to tighten both jam nuts at the same time. Instead, grab the sleeve with a crow’s foot and torque wrench and put an open-end wrench on the jam nuts. Tighten the sleeve to 15 ft/lbs.

If you get a 2005-2011 Toyota RAV4 in your shop for an alignment with a complaint of either rear tire wear or a knocking noise, you need to be aware of a recall and inspection campaign Toyota issued in 2012. Toyota Safety Recall COJ involved inspecting the right and left toe links for looseness. Based upon this inspection, it may have been necessary to replace the arm(s).

Toyota received reports from dealers indicating that some vehicles experienced symptoms of the recalled condition after being inspected or repaired. Toyota discovered that some inspections were not up to standards.

If a lower toe link was inspected and has passed, it will have an epoxy and plastic covering indicating that it passed the inspection. The bad news is that if the cover is there, the toe can’t be adjusted and must be replaced. There are aftermarket toe links that utilize a better design than the original Toyota part.

Camber can be adjusted with an adjustable upper arm. These arms can give an additional three degrees of adjustment. These components can give adjustments for the rest of the life of the vehicle and allow for fine-tuning of the rear camber angles to maximize tire life.

Most 2006-2013 RAV4 models are equipped with an optional Vehicle Stability Control (VSC) system that requires a scan tool and special procedures to perform a zero-point calibration of the steering angle sensor. It is highly recommended to do this through the OBD-II port with a scan tool. Yes, it is possible to reset the system by jumping two pins in the diagnostic connector and disconnecting the battery. But, there is no way to confirm or document the calibration was properly performed.

The steering position sensor’s basic function is to monitor the driver’s steering inputs. This includes the angle of the steering wheel and/or the rate at which the driver is turning the wheel. The steering position sensor on the RAV4 is located behind the steering wheel and is a high-resolution sensor.

The VSC system relies on accurate steering input from the steering angle sensor to analyze a situation and apply appropriate measures to help direct the vehicle on the intended path. If the system is not calibrated after a toe adjustment, the system will not operate properly and may illuminate the VSC malfunction light after the driver has picked up their RAV4.
The Toyota VSC system uses the information from the steering position sensor and compares the information to the yaw rate sensor to determine what the car is doing.

When a vehicle is aligned and the toe in the front or rear is altered, it changes the thrust angle of the vehicle. The thrust angle is directly connected with the slip angle and the measurements taken by the yaw position sensor. Even if you adjust only the rear toe, you are altering the thrust angle, and the steering position sensor must be recalibrated.

After the sensor is reset, it is necessary to drive the vehicle and turn the steering wheel to the right and left at the speed of 22 mph (35 km/h) for at least five seconds to calibrate the sensors and complete the reset. If this is not performed, the VSC may set a code and the sensor may read 1150 degrees. This is not an indication the sensor is faulty, only that it has not been properly reset.

articles.title: Where Steering and Suspension Problems Come From
articles.author: Doug Kaufman

paras.en: Ever drive a vehicle that just doesn’t feel right anymore? Maybe it wanders down the highway. Maybe there’s a clunk every time you hit a pothole. Maybe the steering wheel isn’t centered, the tires are wearing unevenly, or it just doesn’t inspire the confidence it used to.

The truth is, steering and suspension problems rarely come from a single worn out part. Every control arm, ball joint, tie rod, sway bar link, and bushing work together as one connected system. When one connection starts to wear, it puts added stress on the rest of the system, and before long, that small problem becomes several bigger ones.
That system level approach is exactly how TrakMotive has positioned its Suspensia brand chassis program. Learn more about it in this video, sponsored by TrakMotive.

articles.title: Hunter Updates HawkEye XL Commercial Alignment System
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: Hunter Engineering announced four new enhancements to its HawkEye XL Commercial Alignment System.
The new enhancements include (with descriptions by the company):

1) Magnetic wheel adapters – These adapters provide increased wheel protection, with no metal spades to get between the rim and tire, the company says. The adapters are available as an option for new and existing HawkEyeXL aligners.

2) Drive-through sensor configuration – The new configuration will allow drive-through shops and OEM production to skip repositioning their equipment for each alignment. The sensors offer the same long-range vision and field of view, with up to 16-foot-wide tower spacing to accommodate commercial vehicles.

3) New WinAlign software – Hunter’s latest WinAlign 18.3 software offers new target placement guidance to help the technician, aligner placement guidance so the cameras can easily see all the wheel targets, and the flexibility to perform thrustline and frame-reference alignments as desired.

4) Latest-generation alignment cart – Technicians can store adapters and control the alignment system from the rear of the vehicles. The cart is completely untethered with a battery backup, allowing a full day’s work without carrying a cable around the shop, the company says.
The XL handles heavy-duty, medium-duty, light-duty and passenger vehicles.

articles.title: MotoRad CEO Matt Buchholz on Aligning Values
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: This episode of DriveTime features Matt Buchholz, CEO of MotoRad. In this interview, Buchholz described how the company’s D.R.I.V.E. core values — Dedication, Relationship, Innovation, Value Driven and Expertise — provide the cultural foundation for how its team operates internally and engages with customers and channel partners.

Buchholz emphasized that culture and strategy are closely connected. By aligning teams around common values and empowering employees to live them every day, he said MotoRad creates a foundation for continuous improvement — reflecting his philosophy that when an organization gets better, it gets bigger.

As MotoRad expands across thermal management, emissions and powertrain controls, Buchholz said investment decisions begin with market intelligence and listening directly to customers. The company looks for opportunities that fit its existing capabilities and strategy while addressing clear market needs. Buchholz said it also evaluates adjacent categories for “low friction” opportunities where it can create value quickly. articles.title: Battery Thermal Management Market to Hit $10.97B by 2033
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: The battery thermal management system (BTMS) market is projected to grow from $5.26 billion in 2026 to $10.97 billion by 2033 at a CAGR of 11.1%, according to MarketsandMarkets. Increasing battery energy density, fast-charging requirements, higher power output, and stringent battery safety requirements are driving value and technology intensity in BTMS.

OEMs are transitioning from conventional air cooling toward liquid-cooled and integrated thermal architectures to manage battery temperature with greater precision and efficiency. Technology is also shifting toward AI-based thermal simulation, cell-level temperature monitoring, direct cell cooling, and intelligent controls, particularly for high-voltage 800V EV platforms requiring faster charging and tighter thermal uniformity. 800V BTMS solutions are being developed with higher coolant flow, faster preconditioning, and integrated battery heating and cooling to manage higher charging loads, according to the MarketsandMarkets report.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: MAHLE Expands Battery Cooling Plate Production in Spain

In June 2026, MAHLE started series production of battery cooling plates at its Montblanc plant in Spain to support growing demand for liquid-cooled battery systems. The company plans to increase production from around 1,000 units per week to 8,000 units per week by the end of 2026, with the facility capable of reaching up to 15,000 units per week.

The cooling plates use optimized coolant channels to distribute heat uniformly across the battery and maintain operating temperatures below 40°C. MAHLE is also expanding the production area by around 10,000 m², supporting higher-volume production of battery thermal management components.
Webasto Develops Heated Chiller for Integrated Thermal Management

In December 2025, Webasto developed its Heated Chiller to combine battery cooling, battery heating, and cabin heating within a single thermal management unit. The system integrates the chiller, battery heater, and interior heater, reducing component count and simplifying thermal system integration.

The architecture supports coordinated temperature control across the battery and cabin, enabling battery preconditioning for charging while also meeting cabin heating requirements. Webasto is positioning the Heated Chiller as a compact thermal management solution for electric vehicles, with the technology progressing toward production applications.
BEV Segment Expected to Lead Global BTMS Market

The BEV segment is expected to have the largest share in the global BTMS market. BEVs are expected to be the fastest-growing vehicle type, as they account for more than 50% globally, supported by higher battery energy density, tighter cell temperature-control requirements, and greater integration of battery and vehicle thermal systems.

Within passenger BEVs, NMC batteries require active thermal control as higher energy density and charging power increase heat generation and cell temperature variation. This supports liquid cooling, direct cell cooling, battery preconditioning, and active temperature control. OEMs and BTMS suppliers are focusing on integrated and actively controlled thermal architectures.

For instance, the Mercedes AMG GT 4-Door Coupe uses direct cooling of cylindrical NCMA battery cells, with intelligent thermal management controlling cell temperature during high-power operation, while Bosch provides intelligent battery temperature control and diagnostics for BEVs.

These developments are increasing the need for optimized coolant distribution, low-thermal-resistance cooling structures, and coordinated thermal control across the battery, heat pump, HVAC, electric motor, and power electronics. High energy density batteries and higher charging power are supporting demand for advanced active BTMS solutions, particularly for NMC-based passenger BEVs.
